stories.headline: CBJJE National BJJ Championships Day 2: Black Belt Finals in Full Swing, Champions Crowned Sunday
stories.summary: The 2026 CBJJE National BJJ Championships are in their second of three days in Brazil, with adult black belt divisional finals taking center stage; Day 3 (August 2) will crown national champions across all weight categories in the largest gi federation event of the pre-ADCC summer, streaming live on FloGrappling.

stories.headline: ADCC Krakow 42 Days Out: All 128 Camps Underway, August 24 Final Roster Deadline Confirmed
stories.summary: With 42 days until ADCC 2026 (Sept 12-13, Tauron Arena Krakow), all 128 grapplers are in intensive pre-tournament camp; ADCC confirmed August 24 as the absolute final deadline for roster adjustments, adding certainty to a $362,000 prize-pool event headlined by the Duarte-Simoes superfight and featuring a full 128-athlete bracket.

stories.headline: Post-WNO Landscape: UFC BJJ 10 Now the Last Major No-Gi Card Before ADCC Krakow
stories.summary: With Who's Number One on indefinite hiatus and the gi season complete, UFC BJJ 10 (August 20, Meta Apex, free on YouTube) stands as the final high-profile no-gi event before September's ADCC World Championship — the three-title-fight card featuring the inaugural Women's Flyweight Grand Prix is now the grappling community's last competitive tune-up before Krakow.

stories.headline: Atletico vs. Man United Today in Stockholm — Simeone's Full Squad Takes the Field for First Real Test
stories.summary: Atletico Madrid and Manchester United meet at Strawberry Arena today (3pm CET) in Simeone's most meaningful pre-season fixture: all 13 World Cup returnees are now integrated and summer signings Grimaldo, Hjulmand, and Lee Kang-in line up together for the first time in a competitive setting ahead of La Liga's August 16 opener.

stories.headline: Alvarez PSG Move Nearing Completion: Club Agreement in Place, Personal Terms Done, Deal Expected Before Aug 16
stories.summary: Multiple sources confirm PSG and Atletico Madrid have a working framework agreement for Julian Alvarez (reportedly around EUR 150M+), with the player's personal terms also agreed; the transfer is now expected to be completed before La Liga's August 16-17 opener, though Atletico maintain Alvarez is training normally and no deal is officially announced.

stories.headline: Atletico Striker Crisis: Alvarez to PSG + Sorloth to Spurs Leaves No. 9 Vacancy Before La Liga Kicks Off
stories.summary: With Alvarez nearing PSG and Sorloth bound for Tottenham, Atletico face a genuine striker void heading into their La Liga title defense — Lookman is the only natural finisher remaining on the books, and Simeone must secure a replacement before August 16's opener at Espanyol or rely on an improvised attacking structure.

stories.headline: AAPL Craters 8-10% at Open — Weak Guidance Wipes $430B in Market Cap Despite Earnings Beat
stories.summary: Apple shares opened down roughly 8.6% Friday to around $307 — their worst opening move since August 2024 — after Q3 earnings beat on revenue ($109.42B) and EPS ($2.02) but weak forward guidance shocked investors: executives flagged supply constraints and guided only 9-11% revenue growth, below the 11.8% consensus, in what was also Tim Cook's final earnings call as CEO.

stories.headline: Amazon +12% as Tech Earnings Diverge; SPOT Rises to $495 With 3 Days to Tuesday August 4 Report
stories.summary: Big Tech earnings split is sharp today: Amazon surges 12% on its record $200B Q2 while Apple sinks 8-10% on supply-constraint guidance; Spotify (SPOT) gains around 2.5% to $495 ahead of its Tuesday August 4 Q2 report, where analysts project $3.29 EPS (up 783% YoY) and $5.6B revenue — released pre-market Tuesday morning.

stories.headline: VTI in a Bifurcated Market: Mag 7 Splits as Cloud AI Plays Lead, Hardware Sellers Lag
stories.summary: Apple's supply-constraint miss versus Amazon's AWS surge crystallizes August's key theme for VTI holders: the Magnificent Seven are diverging sharply by AI exposure type, with cloud-infrastructure plays pulling ahead of hardware sellers; the S&P 500 opened cautiously mixed Friday as investors assessed which earnings winners can sustain gains into August.

stories.headline: Watershed Butterfly Festival Today in Pennington — Live Butterflies, Insect Parade, Science Exhibits
stories.summary: The Watershed Institute's Butterfly Festival runs today (August 1, 9:30am-3pm) at 31 Titus Mill Road, Pennington NJ (about 30 min from Montclair), with guided butterfly-house tours, a butterfly and insect parade, hands-on animal exhibits, and science activities — $10/person or $30/carload up to six, a perfect mid-day family outing.

stories.headline: Warren County Balloon Festival Closing Day Today + Highlands Clam Fest Fireworks at 10pm Tonight
stories.summary: Today is the last day of the Warren County Farmers' Fair and Hot Air Balloon Festival (Harmony Township, about 1hr from Montclair, $10 adults, $5 kids 6-12) with a dusk balloon launch tonight; the 31st Annual Highlands Clam Fest at the Shore also wraps up with live music, a beer garden, food trucks, and a 10pm fireworks display over Snug Harbor Beach.

stories.headline: Montclair August Calendar: Jazz Soundcheck Aug 4, Barknic Fundraiser Aug 8, Vintage Market Aug 15
stories.summary: Three upcoming Montclair-area events: the free Montclair Jazz Festival Soundcheck Series continues at Lackawanna Station this Tuesday August 4 evening; Barknic (Saturday August 8) is a dog-friendly outdoor fundraiser for Wise Animal Rescue with vendors and family activities; and a vintage fair featuring retro clothing, vinyl records, antiques, and furniture comes to downtown Montclair on Saturday August 15.

stories.headline: CBJJE National BJJ Championships Underway July 31–August 2 on FloGrappling
stories.summary: The 2026 CBJJE National BJJ Championships kicked off today and run through August 2, streaming on FloGrappling — the largest gi event broadcast this week and a major title-pathway event for Brazilian federation athletes.

stories.headline: UFC BJJ 10 Full Card: Three Title Fights August 20 — Tackett vs. Gracie Headlines
stories.summary: UFC BJJ 10 (August 20, Meta Apex, free on YouTube) features three title bouts: Andrew Tackett defends the Welterweight belt against Jonnatas Gracie, Ethan Crelinsten meets Renato Canuto for the Lightweight title, and Brianna Ste-Marie debuts against Women's Featherweight champion Rebeca Lima — alongside the Women's Flyweight GP semifinal.

stories.headline: WNO Effectively Goes Dark — FloGrappling GM Confirms Top Grapplers Have Moved On
stories.summary: FloGrappling GM Ben Kovacs confirmed that Who's Number One has gone on an indefinite hiatus, citing top competitors migrating to UFC BJJ and ONE Championship for better pay and exposure — a significant shift in the no-gi landscape just weeks before ADCC Krakow.

stories.headline: Álvarez Transfer Climax: Barcelona Deadline Expires, Player Reportedly Agrees PSG Terms
stories.summary: Barcelona's self-imposed July 31 signing deadline passed without a deal — Atletico's CEO rejected all offers up to €200M — while FourFourTwo reports Álvarez has now agreed personal terms with PSG after the French club's ~€130M offer, a dramatic shift from his earlier preference for Barcelona.

stories.headline: Sørloth–Juventus Deal Collapses; Tottenham Emerge as New Frontrunners
stories.summary: The long-stalled Alexander Sørloth transfer to Juventus has officially fallen apart after the clubs failed to bridge a €10M+ fee gap — Atletico held at €40M, Juventus refused to exceed €30M; Tottenham have now entered the race and are reportedly the new frontrunners for the Norwegian striker.

stories.headline: Ter Stegen Joins Ajax on Loan as Barcelona Clears Wages for Álvarez Push
stories.summary: Barcelona have agreed to send goalkeeper Marc-André ter Stegen to Ajax on loan, freeing significant wages — part of a broader financial restructuring alongside a €210M TV rights advance that signals the club's all-in commitment to signing Julián Álvarez from Atletico Madrid.

stories.headline: Apple Q3: Revenue Beat but Services and China Miss — Stock Down 3–4% After Hours in Cook's Final Call
stories.summary: Apple posted $109.42B in Q3 revenue (+16% YoY) and EPS of $2.02, both beating consensus, but services revenue of $30.74B missed the $31.22B target and China sales of $18.8B fell short — sending shares down 3–4% after hours in Tim Cook's farewell earnings call before John Ternus takes over as CEO.

stories.headline: Amazon Posts First-Ever $200B Quarter — AWS Grows 37%, EPS More Than Doubles, Stock Surges
stories.summary: Amazon's Q2 was a clean sweep: $200.61B revenue (+19.6% YoY), EPS of $5.75 more than doubling estimates, and AWS growing 36.8% to $42.23B — its fastest pace since 2021; a $53.4B pre-tax gain from the Anthropic stake pushed net income to $62.65B, sending the stock sharply higher after hours.

stories.headline: Markets Stage Broad Recovery July 31 — S&P +1.7%, MSFT +16%, Nasdaq +2.8%; SPOT Up 10.5% Pre-Earnings
stories.summary: Stocks rebounded sharply Thursday: S&P 500 +1.66%, Dow +614 points, Nasdaq +2.8% — led by Microsoft's record +16% single-session gain on Azure's blowout results; Spotify (SPOT) added 10.5% over its pre-earnings week with 4 days to its August 4 Q2 report, where options now imply an 8.6% swing.

stories.headline: MM by Morimoto's Opening Night: Early Reviews Praise Wagyu and Sushi, Flag $300 Omakase Value
stories.summary: Now open at 193 Glenridge Ave, Iron Chef Morimoto's Montclair debut is drawing early Yelp and TripAdvisor reviews praising the wagyu and high-end sushi while flagging the 10-course $300 omakase as a tough value proposition — the ambitious restaurant featuring imported Japanese fish, A5 Wagyu, and an omakase bar may need a few weeks to fully gel.

stories.headline: Montclair Farmers Market Opens August 1 at Walnut Street Station — 8am–2pm Every Saturday Through November
stories.summary: The weekly Montclair Farmers' Market runs at 86 Walnut Street (Walnut Street Station) through November every Saturday 8am–2pm, with fresh produce, meats, fish, cheese, baked goods, flowers, and local vendors — a relaxed Saturday morning option before heading to the Warren County Balloon Festival or NJ State Fair.

stories.headline: Free Essex County Concert: Xtreme Queen Tribute at Brookdale Park August 7 at 7:30pm
stories.summary: Essex County's free 2026 Summer Music Concert Series brings Xtreme Queen (Queen tribute band) to Brookdale Park on the Bloomfield/Montclair border on Friday August 7 at 7:30 PM — no tickets, all ages, and a great family evening option leading into the Montclair Jazz Festival weekend (August 15).

stories.headline: UFC BJJ 2 Results: Tackett Retains With D'Arce Choke, Fowler Wins Inaugural LHW Title — All First-Round Finishes
stories.summary: Andrew Tackett retained his welterweight belt by submitting Renato Canuto with a D'Arce choke in round one, while Mason Fowler captured the inaugural UFC BJJ light heavyweight title via rear-naked choke over David Garmo — making it a first-round finish double-header on the free YouTube card from UFC Apex. The undercard also went all submissions, including debut wins for William Tackett and Raquel Canuto.

stories.headline: ADCC 2026 in Crisis: Only ~4 Tickets/Day Sold for 15,000-Seat Krakow Venue With 6 Weeks to Go
stories.summary: With approximately six weeks until the September 12-13 World Championship, ADCC 2026 is reportedly selling only about four tickets per day at Tauron Arena Kraków — a 15,030-seat venue — compounding a rough summer that includes Gordon Ryan's retirement, Nicholas Meregali in doubt with a shoulder injury, the Michell removal controversy, and ADCC quietly deleting its own invite list from its website.

stories.headline: BJJ Stars 19 Tonight in São Paulo: R$200K Masters Absolute, Moicano vs. Pitbull Superfight
stories.summary: BJJ Stars 19 streams live from Vibra São Paulo tonight at 7:40pm ET, headlined by a 16-man Masters absolute bracket with a R$200,000 prize for the champion; UFC lightweight contender Renato Moicano faces Patricky Pitbull in the marquee superfight alongside five additional grappling bouts.

stories.headline: Lookman Debut Brace Leads Atletico 4-1 Over Getafe in Pre-Season Opener
stories.summary: Atletico Madrid opened their 2026-27 pre-season with a 4-1 win over Getafe at Majadahonda, with new signing Ademola Lookman stealing the show with two first-half goals (5', 35'). Arnau Ortiz and Obed Vargas added second-half goals, and crucially both José María Giménez (ankle) and Johnny Cardoso (post-surgery) featured for the first time this season, giving Simeone encouraging fitness news ahead of Saturday's Stockholm friendly.

stories.headline: Nico González Confirmed Permanent at Atletico — ~€36M Deal Agreed With Juventus
stories.summary: Atletico Madrid have confirmed the permanent signing of Nico González from Juventus for approximately €36M after his 2025-26 loan, after the original €32M buy-option clause was not triggered when the Argentine winger failed to reach the 60%-of-matches appearance threshold. With Nico now officially a permanent Atletico player rather than a swap chip, the Sorloth-to-Juventus negotiation must find a new path to close.

stories.headline: PSG Submit Formal Álvarez Bid; Atletico CEO Threatens FIFA Complaint Against Barcelona
stories.summary: The Julián Álvarez transfer saga escalated sharply: PSG submitted a formal offer for the Argentine striker, while Atletico's CEO publicly threatened a FIFA complaint against Barcelona over alleged illegal contact with the player. No deal is done — Atletico remain firm on their valuation — but the transfer is now in an active, confrontational phase that could force resolution before La Liga opens August 16.

stories.headline: Meta EPS Misses by 14%, Stock -10% AH; Microsoft Beats Cleanly — Divergent Big Tech Earnings
stories.summary: Two starkly different Big Tech nights: Meta Q2 revenue hit $60.8B (beat) but EPS of $6.18 badly missed the $7.17 consensus as expenses surged 55% YoY on AI infrastructure, sending the stock down ~10% after hours; meanwhile Microsoft posted record Q4 revenue of $90.0B (+18%) with EPS of $4.74 (12% beat) and Azure growing 27% YoY — though its guided $255-260B FY2027 capex continues to weigh on the AI spending narrative.

stories.headline: Apple Reports Q3 Tonight — Tim Cook's Final Earnings Call; $108.9B Revenue Consensus, $5T Market Cap on the Line
stories.summary: Apple releases Q3 FY2026 results after tonight's close in Tim Cook's final earnings call before John Ternus takes the CEO role; consensus targets $108.9B revenue (+16% YoY) and $1.89 EPS (+20%), with Apple entering the print at ~$338 after recently crossing the $5 trillion market-cap milestone. Analysts will scrutinize services growth, AI capital spending, and early iPhone 18 pricing signals.

stories.headline: Mag 7 Falls 4.8%, Dow -1,153 Points on AI Capex Fears; NJ Mortgage Rate Holds at 7.02%
stories.summary: Big Tech's AI spending blowout rattled the broader market on July 29-30: the Magnificent Seven fell 4.8% (worst day since April 2025), the Dow sank 1,153 points (-2.19%), and the S&P 500 dropped 1.52% as investors question the return on massive capex commitments. NJ homeowners see no relief — the 30-year fixed mortgage rate holds at 7.02%, with the Fed's fifth consecutive hold at 3.5-3.75% having no meaningful effect on rates tethered to bond market yields.

stories.headline: MM by Morimoto Opens Tomorrow (July 31) — Full Hours Confirmed, Resy Reservations Live
stories.summary: Iron Chef Masaharu Morimoto's 12,779-sq-ft Montclair restaurant opens Thursday July 31 at 193 Glenridge Ave with dinner from 5pm nightly (Fri-Sat until midnight); the menu features imported Japanese fish, A5 Wagyu, a custom omakase bar, and USDA Prime steaks — book tonight on Resy as opening-week tables are filling fast.

stories.headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Opens July 31 — MCU Return of Tom Holland, Perfect for the 12-Year-Old
stories.summary: Tom Holland returns as an adult Peter Parker in the latest MCU Spider-Man film opening July 31 in theaters nationwide; directed by Destin Daniel Cretton, Peter has erased himself from the memories of everyone he loves and must face a villain only he can see — advance tickets on sale now at AMC and Cinemark locations throughout NJ.

stories.headline: NJ State Fair Opens Tomorrow Through August 8 — $5 Adults, Kids Under 12 Free, Augusta NJ
stories.summary: The New Jersey State Fair / Sussex County Farm & Horse Show kicks off July 31 through August 8 at the Sussex County Fairgrounds in Augusta, NJ (~55 miles from Montclair), with $5 adult admission and free entry for children 12 and under; highlights include monster trucks, demolition derbies, a horse show, carnival rides, and agricultural exhibits.

stories.headline: UFC BJJ 2 Two Days Out: Weigh-Ins Tomorrow Morning, Ceremonial Faceoffs Stream Live Wednesday Evening
stories.summary: Official weigh-ins for UFC BJJ 2 take place Wednesday morning (July 30) at the UFC Apex, with ceremonial faceoffs streaming live Wednesday evening on UFC YouTube; all 10 bouts are confirmed — Andrew Tackett defends the welterweight title against Renato Canuto in the main event, Mason Fowler vs. David Garmo crowns the inaugural light heavyweight champion in the co-main, and a family subplot sees Tackett's brother and Canuto's wife both debuting on the undercard.

stories.headline: ADCC Krakow 44 Days Out: Elite Camps Deep in Session; Galvao's Reinstatement Makes 77kg the Division to Watch
stories.summary: With 44 days until ADCC 2026 (September 12-13, Tauron Arena Krakow), top grapplers including Kaynan Duarte, Yuri Simoes, and the reinstated Mica Galvao are in intensive training camp; Galvao's return reshapes an already stacked 77kg bracket, making it arguably the most anticipated division at the $362,000 prize-pool world championship alongside the Duarte-Simoes absolute superfight.

stories.headline: UFC BJJ 10 Women's Flyweight Grand Prix August 20: Fornarino vs. Brunacio Headline Inaugural Bracket
stories.summary: With UFC BJJ 2 days away, eyes are already turning to UFC BJJ 10 (August 20, Meta Apex): ADCC double-champion Adele Fornarino — who chose this event over ADCC Krakow — faces Brazilian standout Carol Brunacio in the semifinals of the first-ever UFC BJJ Women's Flyweight Grand Prix, a four-woman bracket that will crown the series' inaugural women's flyweight champion.

stories.headline: PSG Preparing €164M Formal Offer for Alvarez as Atletico-PSG Transfer Alignment Hardens
stories.summary: Multiple transfer sources report PSG is finalizing a formal €164M bid for Julian Alvarez, with Atletico Madrid steering the deal toward Paris rather than Barcelona; Spanish analyst Martin Otin claims Alvarez has already decided on PSG, while the player himself publicly refuses to rule out a future move — the formal offer's arrival could force a resolution before La Liga opens August 16.

stories.headline: Atletico vs. Manchester United Saturday in Stockholm — Full Squad Ready for Simeone's First Complete Pre-Season Test
stories.summary: Three days from Atletico Madrid's August 1 Stockholm friendly at Strawberry Arena (3pm CET), Diego Simeone has his complete squad at Majadahonda for the first time — all World Cup returnees integrated alongside summer signings Grimaldo, Hjulmand, and Kang-in — making this the most important training week of the pre-season ahead of the La Liga title-defense opener away at Espanyol on August 16.

stories.headline: Sorloth-Juventus: Nico Gonzalez Swap Tabled as Clubs Attempt to Bridge the Fee Gap
stories.summary: Into the Calderon reports Juventus have proposed including midfielder Nico Gonzalez in a player-plus-cash arrangement to bridge Atletico's €35-40M asking price and Juventus's reluctance to exceed €30M fixed; with personal terms long since agreed between Sorloth and Juventus, the Gonzalez swap is the latest attempt to unlock a deal stalled for weeks.

stories.headline: Fed Holds at 3.5-3.75% — Warsh Signals Inflation Vigilance at Press Conference, September Hike Odds Rise
stories.summary: The FOMC voted to hold the federal funds rate at 3.5-3.75% today (July 29), the fifth consecutive hold; Fed Chair Kevin Warsh reinforced his hawkish stance at the 2:30pm ET press conference with zero tolerance rhetoric for persistent inflation — markets responded by pushing September hike probability higher, a headwind for NJ homeowners hoping for mortgage rate relief before fall.

stories.headline: Meta and Microsoft Report Tonight After Close — $60B META Quarter, Azure Growth, AI Capex Scale in Focus
stories.summary: Meta Platforms ($7.21 EPS, $60.22B revenue consensus, +27% YoY) and Microsoft ($4.22 EPS, $87.5B revenue, Azure 40-42% growth expected) both report Q2/Q4 FY2026 results after today's close; investors are focused on $125-145B in Meta capex commitments and Copilot commercialization at Microsoft — paired beats or misses will directly set sentiment for Apple's report tomorrow and Spotify's August 4 call.

stories.headline: AAPL Earnings Tomorrow: Cook's Final Call as CEO, $1.89 EPS Consensus, iPhone 18 Pricing Signals Expected
stories.summary: Apple reports Q3 FY2026 earnings after tomorrow's close (5pm ET) in Tim Cook's final earnings call before John Ternus takes over as CEO; consensus projects $1.89 EPS on $108.8-110B revenue (+14-17% YoY), with key focus on services growth, AI narrative, and iPhone 18 Pro pricing — analysts suggest a ~$270 premium over the iPhone 17 Pro may be needed to sustain ~47% gross margins amid a global chip shortage.

stories.headline: Warren County Farmers' Fair & Hot Air Balloon Festival This Weekend — Dusk Balloon Launches Aug 1-2
stories.summary: The 2026 Warren County Farmers' Fair & Hot Air Balloon Festival runs August 1-2 at the Warren County Fairgrounds in Harmony Township (~1 hour from Montclair), featuring agricultural exhibits, carnival rides, live music, local food, and the signature event: hot air balloon launches at dusk Saturday and Sunday — one of NJ's most distinctive summer family traditions.

stories.headline: MM by Morimoto Opens TOMORROW (July 31) in Montclair — Tonight Is Last Chance to Book on Resy
stories.summary: Iron Chef Masaharu Morimoto's eagerly awaited MM by Morimoto opens its doors tomorrow (Thursday, July 31) at 193 Glenridge Ave, Montclair, with exclusive fish from Japan, A5 Wagyu beef, and a custom omakase bar — book tonight on Resy to lock in opening-week tables before they're gone; Pig & Butter (401 Orange Rd) also opens tomorrow with its ribbon-cutting at 10am.

stories.headline: Six Flags Great Adventure Boardwalk Nights: Final Weekend Aug 1-2 — Extended Hours, Full Thrills
stories.summary: This weekend (August 1-2) is the last Boardwalk Nights event at Six Flags Great Adventure in Jackson, NJ (~50 minutes from Montclair), with extended park hours, special entertainment, and full access to all rides — a strong option for families with a 12-year-old looking for a high-energy late-summer outing before the series wraps for 2026.

stories.headline: UFC BJJ 2 Three Days Out: Tackett Eyes Series History as Fighters Arrive in Las Vegas
stories.summary: Andrew Tackett heads to the UFC Apex for Thursday's free YouTube stream (8pm ET) with the chance to become the UFC BJJ series' first-ever title defender — no champion has successfully defended since the series launched in January 2026 — while Mason Fowler and David Garmo contest the inaugural light heavyweight title in the co-main.

stories.headline: FloGrappling Bulletin: IBJJF Worlds Delivers Memorable Performances — Gi Season Closes, No-Gi Takes Over
stories.summary: FloGrappling's latest Grappling Bulletin declares IBJJF Worlds an 'incredible event' with standout performances across divisions; with the gi season now complete, elite attention shifts entirely to UFC BJJ 2 this Thursday and ADCC Krakow (September 12-13, 46 days away).

stories.headline: July 2026 BJJ Rankings: Duarte-Simões Lead Absolute, Crevar's 21-Win Streak Tops Women's -60kg
stories.summary: Jits Magazine's July rankings update reflects the settled post-trials landscape: Kaynan Duarte and Yuri Simões sit atop the absolute rankings ahead of their ADCC Krakow superfight, while Helena Crevar's 21-consecutive-submission streak makes her the overwhelming women's -60kg favorite heading into September.

stories.headline: Full Squad at Majadahonda: All 13 World Cup Players Arrive — Simeone Has Complete Group 4 Days Before Stockholm
stories.summary: Atletico Madrid's complete squad — Spanish champions Baena, Grimaldo, Llorente, and Pubill alongside Argentine finalists Álvarez, Almada, G. Simeone, and Molina — is assembled at Majadahonda for the first time this pre-season today (July 28), giving Diego Simeone four full group sessions before the August 1 Stockholm friendly against Manchester United.

stories.headline: PSG Now Third Club Chasing Álvarez — Argentine Committed for Now but Won't Rule Out Future Move
stories.summary: Paris Saint-Germain have entered formal dialogue about Julián Álvarez, joining Arsenal (Gyokeres swap) and blocked Barcelona in the race for the Argentine World Cup finalist; Álvarez publicly remains committed to Atletico's La Liga title defense but has stopped short of ruling out a future move to PSG or Barcelona.

stories.headline: Sørloth Impasse: Atletico and Juventus Still €5-10M Apart as Pre-Season Opens With No Deal Imminent
stories.summary: Alexander Sørloth's move to Juventus remains unresolved as Atletico's pre-season begins in earnest: the clubs are stuck €5-10M apart (Atletico at €35-40M, Juventus around €25-30M plus bonuses) with personal terms agreed but the fee gap delaying Atletico's ability to reinvest funds from the sale.

stories.headline: AAPL Sets All-Time High $339.57 — Surpasses Nvidia as World's Most Valuable Company at $4.96T, 2 Days to Earnings
stories.summary: Apple shares hit a record $339.57 on Monday (July 27), pushing market cap to $4.96T and retaking the world's most valuable company title from Nvidia; the next milestone is $5T — achievable with a roughly 1% further gain — and Thursday's Q3 earnings call ($1.89 EPS consensus, $108.8B revenue) marks Tim Cook's final appearance as CEO before John Ternus takes over.

stories.headline: FOMC Opens 2-Day Meeting Today — Rate Hold Expected Tomorrow, 82% September Hike Odds; Meta and Microsoft Report After Bell
stories.summary: The FOMC begins its July 28-29 meeting today with the federal funds rate at 3.50-3.75%; markets price a 65% probability of no change on Wednesday, but September rate hike odds have climbed to 82% — the decision arrives at 2pm ET Wednesday followed by Meta and Microsoft earnings after bell, then Apple and Amazon Thursday.

stories.headline: NJ 30-Year Refinance Edges Up to 6.87% Ahead of FOMC — SPOT at $495 With 7 Days to August 4 Report
stories.summary: New Jersey's 30-year fixed refinance rate ticked up to ~6.87% (from 6.70% last week) as FOMC uncertainty and residual oil pressure keep bond yields elevated; a hawkish Wednesday statement could push rates back toward 7%, while Spotify (SPOT, near $495) enters the final week before August 4 Q2 earnings with $3.29 EPS consensus — a 785% YoY jump — and operating income as the key re-rating catalyst.

stories.headline: Montclair Film Announces Free Zootopia 2 Outdoor Screening — August 29 at Brookdale Park, Sundown
stories.summary: Montclair Film has added Zootopia 2 to its free Movie Nights Under the Stars series, screening at Essex County Brookdale Park (archery field) on Saturday August 29 at sundown (doors at 7pm) — a great late-summer family night with no tickets required; registration recommended at montclairfilm.org for weather alerts, rain date is Sunday August 30.

stories.headline: $6.7M Vision Zero Investment: 12 Montclair Intersections to Get Major Safety Upgrades
stories.summary: Montclair is activating $6.7 million in intersection safety upgrades at 12 high-risk locations as part of its Vision Zero initiative targeting zero traffic fatalities by 2028 — improvements include bollards, solar radar speed signs, and signal upgrades at the township's most dangerous crossings, good news for families navigating Montclair on foot or by bike.

stories.headline: New Montclair Traffic Calming: Linden Ave Goes One-Way, Speed Limits Reduced on Multiple Streets
stories.summary: Montclair has reconfigured Linden Avenue to one-way traffic between Orange Road and Willowdale Avenue as a traffic calming measure, accompanied by speed limit reductions on key streets — part of the township's ongoing effort to lower crash rates following the addition of 14 new multi-way stops in 2024-25 under the Vision Zero roadmap.

stories.headline: UFC BJJ 2 Four Days Out: Tackett Can Become First-Ever Title Defender in Series History
stories.summary: No UFC BJJ championship has been defended since the series launched in January 2026 — Andrew Tackett enters Thursday's free YouTube stream (8pm ET, UFC Apex Las Vegas) with the chance to make history against Renato Canuto, while Mason Fowler and David Garmo contest the inaugural UFC BJJ light heavyweight title in the co-main.

stories.headline: ADCC Krakow 47 Days Out: Training Camps Underway, Duarte-Simões Superfight and $362K Prize Pool in Focus
stories.summary: With exactly 47 days until ADCC 2026 (September 12-13, Tauron Arena Krakow), top contenders including Kaynan Duarte and Yuri Simões are in intensive training camp; the $362,000 prize-money event features the duo's anticipated superfight as its centerpiece, while women's -60kg frontrunner Helena Crevar carries a 21-consecutive-submission streak into what could be a historically dominant divisional performance.

stories.headline: No-Gi's Busiest Summer: UFC BJJ 2 Thursday, UFC BJJ 10 Women's Grand Prix August 20, ADCC September 12
stories.summary: Three marquee events in seven weeks cement submission grappling's biggest commercial moment: UFC BJJ 2 (free, July 31), the first Women's Flyweight Grand Prix at UFC BJJ 10 (August 20), and ADCC Krakow's 128-athlete world championship (September 12-13) — a sequence that solidifies no-gi's fastest-ever expansion across UFC, ADCC, and Fight to Win platforms.

stories.headline: Atletico's 13 World Cup Stars Begin Returning to Majadahonda — Full Squad Assembly Starts Today
stories.summary: Atletico Madrid's World Cup contingent, including Spanish champions Baena, Grimaldo, Llorente, and Pubill plus Argentine finalists Álvarez, Almada, G. Simeone, and Molina, is beginning to check in at the Majadahonda training ground today and tomorrow (July 27-28), giving Diego Simeone his first near-complete session before the August 1 Stockholm pre-season opener against Manchester United.

stories.headline: Sorloth-Juventus Deadlocked Over ~€10M Fee Gap — Transfer Stalling With Atletico Pre-Season Underway
stories.summary: The Alexander Sørloth departure from Atletico to Juventus remains unresolved: Atletico are holding firm at €35-40M while Juventus have proposed around €25-30M fixed plus bonuses, leaving a ~€10M gap despite personal terms already agreed by the Norwegian striker — an unresolved subplot as Simeone's squad prepares for the August 1 Stockholm friendly.

stories.headline: Stockholm Five Days Out: Simeone Gets First Full-Squad Look at Grimaldo, Hjulmand, and Kang-in Together
stories.summary: With World Cup returnees arriving this week, August 1's Atletico vs. Manchester United friendly at Strawberry Arena, Stockholm (3pm CET) will be Simeone's first opportunity to field his three summer signings — left-back Alejandro Grimaldo, defensive midfielder Morten Hjulmand, and South Korean playmaker Lee Kang-in — alongside the core of the La Liga title-winning squad.

stories.headline: Oil Crashes 4-5% on Iran Ceasefire Pause — Markets Open Sharply Green With S&P Futures +0.79%, Nasdaq +1.34%
stories.summary: A pause in US military strikes against Iran sent Brent crude tumbling 4.41% to $87.64 (from last week's $100+) and WTI down 4.93% to $84.91 on Monday morning, lifting S&P 500 futures 0.79% and Nasdaq 100 futures 1.34% — a sharp reversal of the geopolitical risk premium that had dragged VTI and tech stocks to their worst weekly loss since March.

stories.headline: AAPL Surges to $333 Near Record Highs — Three Days to Tim Cook's Farewell Earnings Call and Foldable iPhone Debut Hints
stories.summary: Apple stock rallied 3.53% to $333 Monday on oil retreat relief and pre-earnings positioning, approaching all-time highs three days before Thursday's Q3 report ($1.89 EPS consensus, $108.9B revenue); alongside Tim Cook's final call before CEO successor John Ternus, investors will scrutinize iPhone 17 demand and early signals on Apple's foldable phone entry — Counterpoint Research forecasts a 25% global share in Apple's debut foldable year.

stories.headline: Megacap Gauntlet Week: FOMC Tuesday-Wednesday, Meta & MSFT Wednesday, Amazon & Apple Thursday — 34% Chance of Rate Hike
stories.summary: The most consequential stretch of 2026's earnings season is now underway: the FOMC meets Tuesday-Wednesday (hawkish hold expected but 34% odds of a surprise hike), Meta and Microsoft report after Wednesday's close, and Amazon and Apple follow Thursday — while Spotify (SPOT, August 4, 8 days) and New Jersey's 6.87% 30-year refinance rate both hang on whether megacap beats can shift the Fed's messaging and bring bond yields lower.

stories.headline: Two Downtown Montclair Retail Closings: Urban Outfitters and 24-Year-Old Culture Couture Gift Shop
stories.summary: Montclair's downtown retail landscape shifted this week with two closings: Urban Outfitters is shutting its longtime Church Street location as part of a national chain-wide contraction, while Culture Couture — an independent gift shop at 53 Church Street that has served the community for 24 years — is closing its brick-and-mortar storefront, the latest change in a downtown that is simultaneously gaining 23 new businesses.

stories.headline: Clary Anderson Arena Under New Management: Montclair Takes Direct Control of Ice Rink From Outside Operator
stories.summary: Montclair has resumed direct management of Clary Anderson Arena, replacing the outside rink-management company that previously operated the facility; community volunteers are assisting with operations during the transition, following earlier public reports of serious condition issues — the new arrangement signals a fresh chapter for one of the town's key recreational venues.

stories.headline: Annie at bergenPAC July 31–August 2 in Englewood — 15th-Anniversary Youth Production, Tickets From $37
stories.summary: Bergen Performing Arts Center's Performing Arts School presents Annie at bergenPAC's Taub Stage (30 N Van Brunt St, Englewood, NJ) from July 31 through August 2, celebrating the program's 15th anniversary — performances July 31 at 7pm, August 1 at 3pm, and August 2 at 3pm, tickets from $37; an easy drive from Montclair and an ideal family outing coinciding with the Morimoto restaurant opening the same day.

stories.headline: F2W 322 Fresno Wraps Up Today — California No-Gi Summer Swing Complete, ADCC Camp Mode Begins
stories.summary: Fight to Win 322 concluded its Fresno card today (Saturday July 26), closing the California leg of the pre-ADCC summer circuit; with the West Coast swing complete, top ADCC-bound competitors now transition to full training-camp preparation for the September 12-13 World Championship in Krakow.

stories.headline: UFC BJJ 2 Five Days Out — Two Title Fights Free on YouTube Thursday July 31 at 8pm ET
stories.summary: UFC BJJ 2 is five days away at UFC Apex, Las Vegas, streaming free on YouTube at 8pm ET Thursday July 31, headlined by welterweight champion Andrew Tackett vs. Renato Canuto and Mason Fowler vs. David Garmo for the inaugural light heavyweight title — the last major grappling card before ADCC Krakow prep enters its final intensive phase.

stories.headline: ADCC 2026: Full 128-Athlete Field Locked, Elite Grapplers Enter Camp Phase — Krakow 48 Days Away
stories.summary: All eight ADCC 2026 brackets are finalized with 128 confirmed athletes; with the pre-ADCC competition circuit winding down, top contenders including Kaynan Duarte, Yuri Simoes, and Gabi Garcia are entering dedicated training camps ahead of the September 12-13 World Championship at Tauron Arena Krakow — where 14-year-old Joslyn Molina will also make history in the women's -66kg division.

stories.headline: Salah Nearing Besiktas Deal on Ronaldo-Style Contract — Atletico's Free-Agent Target Slips Away
stories.summary: Mohamed Salah appears set to sign with Turkish club Besiktas on a 1+1 year contract at €12M annually, with CaughtOffside (July 25) confirming an agreement in principle and ESPN reporting he is 'nearing the move' — ending Atletico Madrid's months-long pursuit of the free-agent Egyptian forward and forcing the club to pivot their summer striker hunt.

stories.headline: Atletico's Striker Crisis: Salah Gone, Sorloth Departing — Gyokeres Swap With Arsenal Now the Only Path to a No. 9
stories.summary: With Salah trending to Besiktas and Alexander Sorloth still en route to Juventus (personal terms agreed, clubs ~€5M apart on fee), Atletico face a genuine striker void; ESPN and Into the Calderon report the club are now more open to the Gyokeres-for-Alvarez swap with Arsenal — but only if Alvarez goes to the Premier League, not Barcelona, as Atletico's stance on their La Liga rivals remains firm.

stories.headline: World Cup Players Return Monday — Atletico Assembles Near-Full Squad for Stockholm With 6 Days to Go
stories.summary: Atletico Madrid's 13 World Cup participants — including Spanish champions Baena, Grimaldo, Llorente, and Pubill, plus Argentine finalists Alvarez, Almada, and Molina — are expected back at Majadahonda training by Monday July 28, giving Diego Simeone six days of near-full group sessions before the August 1 pre-season opener vs. Manchester United at Strawberry Arena, Stockholm.

stories.headline: Biggest Earnings Week of 2026: Meta & Microsoft Wednesday, Amazon & Apple Thursday — Plus Fed Meeting, GDP and PCE Data
stories.summary: The most consequential week of 2026 earnings season begins Monday with Meta and Microsoft reporting Wednesday (July 29), followed by Amazon and Apple on Thursday (July 30) after the bell; the Fed concludes its Wednesday policy meeting (rate hold expected), Q2 GDP prints Thursday morning, and PCE inflation data follows Friday — a five-day gauntlet that will determine whether the tech-led market selloff of the past two weeks has run its course.

stories.headline: AAPL Enters Earnings Week Near $321 — 4 Days to Tim Cook's Farewell Call; ±5.38% Swing Priced In for July 30
stories.summary: Apple opens the critical week near $321 with the market pricing a ±$16.61 (±5.38%) swing around Thursday July 30's Q3 print ($1.88 EPS consensus, $108.9B revenue, +20% YoY); Tim Cook delivers his final earnings call as CEO before John Ternus succession, with a strong beat on services revenue and AI spend narrative needed to push AAPL toward the $5T market-cap milestone — roughly $19/share above Friday's close.

stories.headline: NJ Refinance Holds at 6.698% as Fed Meets Wednesday; SPOT 9 Days Out — Analysts Shift Focus to Revenue Per User
stories.summary: New Jersey's 30-year fixed refinance APR holds at 6.698% (15-year: 5.83%) heading into the Fed's Wednesday rate decision, where a hold is expected to keep the improvement from the recent 7.02% peak intact; Spotify enters its final 9-day pre-earnings window ahead of its August 4 Q2 report ($3.29 EPS consensus, $5.6B revenue), with analysts now focused on revenue per user and operating income rather than raw subscriber additions.

stories.headline: MM by Morimoto and Pig & Butter Both Open This Thursday July 31 — Montclair's Biggest Dining Day in Years
stories.summary: Iron Chef Masaharu Morimoto's MM by Morimoto opens Thursday July 31 at 193 Glenridge Ave with exclusive fish from Japan, Wagyu beef, a custom omakase bar, and 200+ seats (book via Resy); simultaneously, Pig & Butter at 401 Orange Road celebrates its ribbon-cutting at 10am — two highly anticipated Montclair openings on the same day make July 31 a landmark moment for the local dining scene.

stories.headline: Nocturnal Animals at Van Vleck Gardens This Tuesday July 28 — Live Exotic Wildlife With Eyes of the Wild, 6–7pm
stories.summary: Van Vleck House & Gardens (21 Van Vleck St, Montclair) hosts 'Outdoor Adventures: Nocturnal Animals' this Tuesday July 28 from 6–7pm, featuring live nocturnal animals from Eyes of the Wild exotic animal rescue — a low-key weeknight family outing for children ages 5 and older in one of Montclair's most beautiful garden settings.

stories.headline: Montclair Jazz Festival's Downtown Jamboree + Block Party Confirmed August 15 — 2026 Theme Honors American Jazz Cities
stories.summary: The Montclair Jazz Festival's signature all-day Downtown Jamboree + Block Party is confirmed for Saturday August 15, 2026, celebrating this year's 'American Jazz Cities' theme highlighting Chicago, New York, and New Orleans; the festival's free weekly Soundcheck Series at Lackawanna Station continues on Tuesday evenings through August as a warm-up to the big day.

stories.headline: UFC BJJ 2 Six Days Out: Tackett vs. Canuto, Two Title Fights, Free on YouTube July 31
stories.summary: With UFC BJJ 2 six days away (Thursday July 31, free on YouTube at 8pm ET from UFC Apex, Las Vegas), the double-title card is set: welterweight champion Andrew Tackett defends against submission specialist Renato Canuto in the main event, while Mason Fowler and David Garmo crown the inaugural UFC BJJ light heavyweight champion in the co-main — the free stream marks the second event in a planned 14-card 2026 series.

stories.headline: Fight to Win 322 Tonight in Fresno — Final Pre-ADCC California Stop as Krakow Prep Begins
stories.summary: Fight to Win's California summer double-header wraps tonight with F2W 322 in Fresno — the last West Coast showcase before the grappling community enters full ADCC training-camp mode, with seven weeks remaining until the September 12-13 World Championship in Krakow.

stories.headline: ADCC Krakow Bracket Finalized: Pearman Replaces Michell at 77kg; Hamilton Steps Into Fornarino's -55kg Slot
stories.summary: The ADCC 2026 roster reshuffle is complete: Taylor Pearman slots into the 77kg bracket in place of the removed Izaak Michell, while Valerie Hamilton takes the -55kg women's spot vacated by Adele Fornarino, who chose the UFC BJJ 10 Women's Flyweight Grand Prix over Krakow — closing the book on five competitor withdrawals ahead of the September 12-13 World Championship.

stories.headline: Alvarez-Gyokeres Swap Still Frozen — Player Wants Barcelona, Atletico Won't Budge
stories.summary: Reports from CaughtOffside (July 25) confirm the Arsenal-Atletico framework pairing Viktor Gyokeres plus cash for Julian Alvarez remains in place but completely stalled: Alvarez wants Barcelona, Atletico refuses to sell him there as a matter of principle, and with the August 1 Stockholm friendly one week away Simeone's side shows no sign of breaking the deadlock.

stories.headline: One Week to Pre-Season: Atletico vs. Man United in Stockholm August 1 at Strawberry Arena
stories.summary: Atletico Madrid's 2026-27 pre-season opener is exactly one week away — Saturday August 1 at 3pm CET at Strawberry Arena, Stockholm vs. Manchester United — when Simeone gets his first look at summer arrivals Grimaldo, Hjulmand, and Kang-in together in a competitive environment ahead of the La Liga title defense opener at Espanyol (August 16-17).

stories.headline: La Liga 2026-27 Season Opens August 16-17 — Atletico Away at Espanyol's RCDE Stadium for Title Defense Debut
stories.summary: La Liga's 2026-27 season kicks off the weekend of August 16-17, with Atletico Madrid opening their title defense away at Espanyol's RCDE Stadium — giving Simeone's revamped squad just two pre-season tests (Stockholm vs. Man United Aug 1, Seoul vs. Man City Aug 9) to integrate three summer signings before competitive action begins.

stories.headline: Markets Post Worst Week Since March — Brent Hits $100, S&P 500 Down 0.6%, Nasdaq Off 2%
stories.summary: All three major US indices closed the week of July 21-25 in the red: the S&P 500 fell 0.6% to 7,411 and the Nasdaq lost 2% — its second consecutive weekly decline — as Brent crude's surge past $100/barrel on Houthi tanker attacks and Iran tensions added an inflation premium dragging VTI from recent highs; Apple's July 30 earnings report is now the single most-watched market event of the summer.

stories.headline: AAPL Five Days to July 30 Earnings — BofA and Morgan Stanley Expect a Beat; Tim Cook's Farewell Call
stories.summary: Bank of America and Morgan Stanley both project Apple will beat the $1.88 EPS consensus (48-49% gross margin) when it reports Q3 FY2026 results on July 30 (after close, 5pm ET); shares close near $321 — the $5T market cap milestone sits about $19/share above Friday's close — and July 30 marks Tim Cook's final earnings call before John Ternus succeeds him as Apple CEO.

stories.headline: SPOT 10 Days to August 4 Earnings Near $492; NJ 30-Year Refinance Holds ~6.70% as Oil Tops $100
stories.summary: Spotify shares (near $492, Q2 EPS consensus $3.29 — a 785% YoY jump) are 10 days from their August 4 earnings call, with the AI remixing feature timeline the key re-rating catalyst; separately, New Jersey's 30-year fixed refinance rate holds around 6.70%, but Brent crude above $100 is adding bond-yield pressure that could push rates back toward 7% if geopolitical tensions don't ease before mid-August.

stories.headline: Collective Comedy Festival Closing Night Tonight at Studio Playhouse — Tristan Bowling Headlines at 8:30pm
stories.summary: Montclair's Collective Comedy Festival wraps its annual multi-day run tonight (Saturday July 25) at Studio Playhouse and Tierney's Tavern, with comedian Tristan Bowling headlining the final night — doors at 8pm, showtime 8:30pm, a fun adult evening option while the Theater Festival at Brookdale Park winds down this afternoon.

stories.headline: 'Best in Show' Free at Anderson Park Tomorrow — Pre-Show Dog Parade 6:30pm, Christopher Guest Film 7pm
stories.summary: Montclair Film's Movie Night Under the Stars screens Christopher Guest's comedy 'Best in Show' (2000) free at Anderson Park (274 Bellevue Ave, Montclair) tomorrow Sunday July 26 at 7pm, with a pre-show dog parade at 6:30pm — registration recommended at montclairfilm.org, rain date August 2.

stories.headline: Free Sunday: Church Street Live + Jazz House KiDS at Montclair Brewery, July 27
stories.summary: Sunday July 27 brings two free live music events in Montclair: Church Street Live fills the downtown restaurant corridor with outdoor performances, and Jazz House KiDS's adult ensemble plays at Montclair Brewery — a relaxed, family-friendly close to a packed weekend that started with today's Theater Festival and continues with tomorrow's Anderson Park movie night.

stories.headline: ADCC Krakow Loses 4th Defending Champion — Fornarino Exits for UFC BJJ 10 Grand Prix; Michell Removed
stories.summary: Reigning ADCC -55kg double gold medalist Adele Fornarino has been pulled from the Krakow 2026 roster after choosing to compete in the inaugural Women's Flyweight Grand Prix at UFC BJJ 10 (August 20), while ADCC Asia & Oceania Trials winner Izaak Michell was simultaneously removed over an active Texas arrest warrant — the 4th and 5th departures from a September 12-13 bracket that has now lost five confirmed competitors in quick succession.

stories.headline: UFC BJJ 10 Announces Inaugural Women's Flyweight Grand Prix for August 20 — Fornarino vs. Brunacio Headline
stories.summary: The UFC's no-gi grappling series announced a landmark addition to its August 20 card at the Meta Apex: the first-ever Women's Flyweight Grand Prix at UFC BJJ 10, with ADCC double champion Adele Fornarino facing Brazilian standout Carol Brunacio in the tournament semifinals — the winner of the four-woman bracket will be crowned the inaugural UFC BJJ Women's Flyweight Champion.

stories.headline: PSS 7 Tonight in Miami: Jacob Rodriguez vs. Vagner Rocha Live at Karate Combat 62 — ADCC 7 Weeks Out
stories.summary: Tonight's Karate Combat 62 / Pit Submission Series 7 card in Miami features Jacob Rodriguez ending a 17-month competitive absence against veteran Vagner Rocha in the PSS main event — a high-stakes grappling match just seven weeks before ADCC Krakow, with both men expected to compete at the September 12-13 World Championship.

stories.headline: Reports: Arsenal and Atletico Reach Framework Agreement on Gyokeres-Alvarez Swap — Alvarez's Approval the Last Hurdle
stories.summary: Football365 reports Arsenal and Atletico Madrid have agreed on a deal structure — Viktor Gyokeres plus €50M cash for Julian Alvarez — but the transfer remains stalled as Alvarez still prefers a move to Barcelona, a destination Atletico refuses to facilitate regardless of the fee on offer.

stories.headline: Man United Stumble 1-0 to Wrexham in Pre-Season Opener Ahead of August 1 Atletico Stockholm Test
stories.summary: Manchester United began their 2026-27 pre-season with a 1-0 defeat to Championship club Wrexham in Helsinki, then face Rosenborg in Trondheim before traveling to Stockholm for the August 1 friendly against La Liga champions Atletico Madrid — a match that will serve as the first meaningful test for both clubs' summer signings.

stories.headline: Atletico's New Trio Ready for Stockholm — Grimaldo, Hjulmand, and Kang-in Set for First Pre-Season Test
stories.summary: With world cup finalists returning to Majadahonda by July 28, Atletico Madrid's three summer signings — left-back Alejandro Grimaldo, holding midfielder Morten Hjulmand, and creative South Korean midfielder Lee Kang-in — will finally train with the full squad ahead of the August 1 Stockholm friendly, giving Simeone his first real look at the new-look La Liga champions in a competitive setting.

stories.headline: Tesla Tanks 14.5% on Q2 Earnings Miss — S&P 500 Sinks 1.21%, Nasdaq Falls 2.15%, VTI Under Pressure
stories.summary: Tesla's Q2 report (July 23) beat on revenue ($28.2B, +26% YoY) but badly missed on profits — EPS $0.33 vs. $0.51 expected, operating margin collapsing to just 1.4% — sending TSLA down roughly 14.5% and dragging the S&P 500 -1.21% to 7,408 and Nasdaq -2.15% to 25,137; VTI came under pressure as the Mag 7 rotation continues, with Apple's July 30 print now the market's single most critical near-term catalyst.

stories.headline: AAPL at $321.66 With 6 Days to Earnings — Citi Lifts Target to $365, Tim Cook's Final Call as CEO Approaches
stories.summary: Apple shares are consolidating at $321.66 (down 0.56% Thursday) with just six days until the July 30 Q3 earnings call where EPS consensus stands at $1.88 on ~$109B revenue; Citi analyst Asiya Merchant raised her price target to $365 on July 13 on margin optimism, and in a significant milestone, July 30 will mark Tim Cook's final earnings call before John Ternus takes over as Apple CEO.

stories.headline: SPOT +2.97% Outperforms Falling Market — 11 Days to August 4 Earnings; NJ Refinance Rates Ease to 6.70%
stories.summary: Spotify shares gained 2.97% despite broad market weakness (11 days to August 4 Q2 earnings), with investor optimism building around cost discipline and operating income growth ahead of the report; separately, New Jersey's 30-year fixed refinance rate eased to 6.698% from its recent 7.02% peak — a modest relief for homeowners who've been waiting for a better entry window.

stories.headline: Free Outdoor Concert Tonight at Brookdale Park — The Infernos Headline Essex County Summer Music Series
stories.summary: Tonight (Friday July 24) the Essex County free summer music series presents The Infernos at Brookdale Park on the Bloomfield/Montclair border — a no-cost outdoor show perfect for families heading into the Montclair Theater Festival weekend, and part of a recurring county series running throughout July and August.

stories.headline: Newark Museum of Art Family Days Close Sunday July 26 — ‘Stars Are Everywhere’ Clay Seastars Workshop This Weekend
stories.summary: The Newark Museum of Art's summer Family Fun Days run through this Sunday July 26 with a ‘Stars are everywhere’ theme — families can make textured Seastars from air-dry clay in hands-on workshops ideal for kids; it's a 30-minute drive from Montclair and a great complement to weekend theater festival or beach plans before the program wraps.

stories.headline: Storytime With a Twist at Bloomfield Library — Balloon Animal Crafts for Kids Tomorrow, July 25 at 11am
stories.summary: Bloomfield Public Library (minutes from Montclair) hosts Storytime with a Twist this Saturday July 25 at 11am, where children and caregivers read books together and then make their own balloon animals — a free, hands-on Saturday morning outing perfect for families looking for a calm alternative to the busy theater festival across town.

stories.headline: Mica Galvao Reinstated to ADCC Krakow 77kg Roster — Reversal Reshapes Most Contested Division
stories.summary: FloGrappling's latest Grappling Bulletin confirms Mica Galvao has returned to the ADCC 2026 Krakow roster following his earlier withdrawal, a significant reversal that reshapes the stacked 77kg bracket at the September 12-13 World Championship and gives the division its full complement of elite contenders.

stories.headline: 17-Year-Old Matilda Reid Wins ADCC Asia & Oceania +65kg in Gold Coast — 8 Athletes Qualify for Krakow
stories.summary: Blue belt Matilda Reid, 17, dominated the +65kg bracket at the ADCC Asia & Oceania Trials in Gold Coast, Australia, defeating four more experienced opponents to claim the division title in what FloGrappling called the trials' standout result; all eight division champions — including Kaya Rudolph (-77kg, New Zealand) and Bekzat Kapashov (-66kg, Kazakhstan) — have punched their tickets to the September 12-13 World Championship.

stories.headline: UFC BJJ 2 Co-Main Preview: Fowler vs. Garmo to Crown the First-Ever Light Heavyweight Champion
stories.summary: With eight days until UFC BJJ 2 (July 31, free on YouTube at 8pm ET), the Fowler-Garmo co-main event is shaping up as the bout to watch — Mason Fowler brings a three-fight UFC BJJ submission run against a surging David Garmo, and the inaugural light heavyweight title gives the matchup lasting significance beyond a single night.

stories.headline: Koke Renews Contract With Atletico Madrid Until June 2027 — One-Club Captain Commits for La Liga Title Defense
stories.summary: Club captain Jorge Resurrección 'Koke' has signed a one-year contract extension keeping him at Atletico Madrid through June 2027, the club announced, with both parties activating an automatic renewal clause; the 34-year-old one-club man becomes the squad's continuity anchor in a summer that has seen significant turnover around him.

stories.headline: Lee Kang-in Joins Atletico's Pre-Season Training — First Asian Player in Club History Begins Work Under Simeone
stories.summary: South Korean midfielder Lee Kang-in — officially signed from PSG for approximately €35-40M in early July as Atletico's third summer arrival after Grimaldo and Hjulmand — is now integrating with the first-team squad in Majadahonda, giving Simeone a creative, high-energy option in midfield and making Kang-in the first Asian player in Atletico's history.

stories.headline: Atletico's 2026-27 Summer Scorecard: Three In, One Out, Salah Still Pursued Before La Liga Opener
stories.summary: As Atletico's pre-season ramps up toward the August 1 Stockholm friendly vs. Manchester United, the summer transfer picture is mostly set: Grimaldo, Hjulmand, and Kang-in are confirmed signings; Alexander Sorloth's Juventus exit is imminent; Julian Alvarez stays; and Mohamed Salah's free agency remains the one outstanding question Simeone hopes to resolve before the late-August La Liga opener.

stories.headline: Alphabet Q2 Beats on Revenue and Cloud — But GOOGL Sinks ~5% After Hours on Record $200B Capex Guidance
stories.summary: Google parent Alphabet reported Q2 revenue of $119.8B (+24% YoY) with Google Cloud surging 82% to $24.8B, clearing analyst estimates on the top line — but shares fell roughly 5% in after-hours trading after management raised 2026 capex guidance to a projected $200B, an unprecedented scale of AI infrastructure spending that stoked investor concern about returns.

stories.headline: AAPL Holds Near $324 — 7 Days to July 30 Earnings as Alphabet's Capex Shock Complicates Apple's $5T Push
stories.summary: Apple shares are consolidating near $324 with exactly seven days until the July 30 Q3 earnings call ($1.88 EPS consensus, ~$109B revenue), but Alphabet's decline after a strong beat raises the bar for clarity — investors will now scrutinize Apple's AI capital spending commitments closely, and the $5T market-cap milestone requires a roughly 5% post-earnings move from current levels.

stories.headline: US-Iran Tensions Keep Oil Near $85-91; Markets Navigate Geopolitical Risk Ahead of Apple's July 30 Print
stories.summary: Crude oil (Brent) has been trading in an elevated $85-91 range as US military strikes against Iran and ongoing ceasefire mediation talks keep energy markets unsettled — adding an inflation premium that could influence the Fed's September rate path and creating a headwind for VTI just as it approaches 52-week highs in what is already the most important earnings week of the summer.

stories.headline: Montclair Theater Festival THIS SATURDAY July 25: Free Outdoor Seussical + Shakespeare at Brookdale Park, 2-8pm
stories.summary: The 2nd Annual Montclair Theater Festival returns to Brookdale Park this Saturday (July 25, 2-8pm), presented free by Vanguard Theater Company — the all-ages event features abridged professional productions of Seussical the Musical (6pm) and Shakespeare's The Tempest (3pm), plus pop-up performances from 20+ NJ theater companies, food trucks, artisan vendors, and hands-on activities for kids.

stories.headline: Monmouth County Fair Through Sunday July 26 in Freehold: Rides, Live Music, and Classic Fair Food
stories.summary: The 2026 Monmouth County Fair runs through Sunday July 26 at the East Freehold Showgrounds in Freehold (~45 minutes from Montclair), featuring carnival rides, competitive exhibits, live music, and local food vendors — a classic family summer fair that's one of NJ's longest-running county events.

stories.headline: Paper Mill Playhouse Summer Conservatory: 'New Voices of 2026' at Montclair's Memorial Auditorium This Week
stories.summary: Paper Mill Playhouse's prestigious Summer Musical Theater Conservatory presents 'New Voices of 2026: On Vacation' this week at Memorial Auditorium (1 Normal Ave, Montclair State University) — a professional-quality showcase of the next generation of musical theater talent that's ideal for theater-loving families with tweens; check papermill.org for show dates and times.

stories.headline: Musumeci-Mitchell Crossover Officially Scheduled: UFC BJJ 11, September 24, Las Vegas
stories.summary: After weeks as a 'homeless' challenge, the Mikey Musumeci vs. Bryce Mitchell crossover is confirmed for UFC BJJ 11 on September 24 at Meta Apex, Las Vegas; Mitchell becomes the first active UFC fighter to compete in the UFC BJJ series, facing flyweight champion Musumeci (4-0, all submissions) in a non-title featherweight bout, with Mason Fowler defending his UFC BJJ light heavyweight title vs. 2019 ADCC runner-up Nick Rodriguez in the co-main event.

stories.headline: UFC BJJ 2 (July 31) Full Family Card: Tackett's Brother and Canuto's Wife Also Debut on the Free Card
stories.summary: The full 10-bout UFC BJJ 2 card is set for the free July 31 YouTube stream (8pm ET): Andrew Tackett defends his welterweight title vs. Renato Canuto in the main event and Fowler vs. Garmo crowns the inaugural light heavyweight champion in the co-main — a compelling family subplot sees Andrew's brother William Tackett and Renato's wife Raquel Canuto both making their UFC BJJ debuts on the undercard.

stories.headline: UFC BJJ Series Maps to Event 11 — With 14 Cards Planned in 2026, No-Gi's Fastest-Growing League Keeps Expanding
stories.summary: The announcement of UFC BJJ 11 (September 24) — featuring Musumeci-Mitchell headlining and Fowler-Rodriguez in the co-main — shows how quickly the series has scaled since its January 2026 debut; with 14 events planned for the calendar year and a growing roster of champions across weight classes, the UFC's no-gi circuit is cementing its place alongside ADCC, Polaris, and Fight to Win as a top-tier destination for elite grapplers.

stories.headline: Arsenal-Atletico Swap Talks: Viktor Gyokeres Plus €60M Cash Offered for Julian Alvarez
stories.summary: Arsenal have proposed sending Swedish striker Viktor Gyokeres (valued at €65M+) plus approximately €60M cash to Atletico Madrid in exchange for Julian Alvarez — a structure that emerged after Atletico blocked a direct Alvarez sale to La Liga rivals Barcelona 'as a matter of honor'; TEAMtalk reports no agreement has been struck yet but lines of communication between the clubs remain open.

stories.headline: Atletico Pre-Season Week 2: Full Squad Expected by July 28 — Four Days to Prepare for Stockholm Aug 1
stories.summary: Non-World-Cup players are training at Majadahonda this week while Spanish and Argentine World Cup finalists remain on mandatory extended rest; the full group including Grimaldo, Baena, Alvarez, G. Simeone, and Almada is expected to reassemble by July 28, giving Simeone just four training sessions before the August 1 Stockholm friendly vs. Manchester United at Strawberry Arena.

stories.headline: Atletico's Attacking Future in Flux: If Gyokeres Swap Closes, Salah Chase Continues — Entirely New Front Three Possible
stories.summary: Atletico's summer transfer math is evolving rapidly: if the Alvarez-Gyokeres swap closes, the Swedish striker fills the void left by Sorloth's imminent Juventus departure, while the Mohamed Salah free-agent pursuit continues in parallel — Simeone could end the 2026 window with an entirely new front three compared to the La Liga title-winning season.

stories.headline: Alphabet Reports Q2 Tonight After Close — First Mag7 Print Sets Tone for AAPL (July 30) and SPOT (Aug 4)
stories.summary: Alphabet releases its Q2 2026 results after tonight's closing bell (consensus: $2.89 EPS, $116.84B revenue, Google Cloud ~63% YoY growth); options markets are pricing a 5.4% swing in GOOGL, and as the first Magnificent Seven company to report this earnings cycle, the result will directly shape market sentiment heading into Apple's July 30 and Spotify's August 4 reports — the two most consequential remaining prints for VTI and tech broadly.

stories.headline: AAPL 8 Days to July 30 Earnings — Tim Cook's Final Call as CEO Before John Ternus Succession; $5T Cap in Sight
stories.summary: With VTI dipping to 369.45 and Apple shares consolidating near $325-330, the July 30 Q3 earnings call is shaping up as a milestone: analysts project $1.88 EPS on ~$109B revenue, but the bigger story is that July 30 will mark Tim Cook's final earnings call as CEO — hardware executive John Ternus takes over as Apple's next chief, and a strong beat could push AAPL's market cap past $5 trillion for the first time.

stories.headline: SPOT Down 38% From ATH but Bank of America Reiterates 40% Upside — Audiobooks+ Hits $100M ARR Milestone in July
stories.summary: Spotify shares (near $492, down 38% from their June 2025 peak) face a 13-day countdown to August 4 earnings, but Bank of America is reiterating a Buy thesis citing an 'impressive compelling product roadmap'; a positive pre-earnings development: Audiobooks+ is expected to confirm $100M in annualized recurring revenue this month — less than a year after launch and well ahead of schedule — a strong leading indicator for the Q2 earnings call.

stories.headline: Pig & Butter Opening July 31 in Montclair: Brunch-All-Day and Unionville Vineyards Wine at 401 Orange Road
stories.summary: Montclair's newest restaurant, Pig & Butter, brings a dual concept to 401 Orange Road: a full-service brunch, dinner, and cocktail spot featuring wines from Unionville Vineyards alongside a separate coffeehouse and eatery; a ribbon-cutting ceremony is set for July 31 at 10am — the same day MM by Morimoto opens on Glenridge Ave, making July 31 the biggest day for Montclair dining in recent memory.

stories.headline: The Saint Clair Launches Culinary Masters Class Series Tomorrow — 'Summer Seafood Secrets,' July 23, 6:30pm
stories.summary: The Saint Clair restaurant in Montclair kicks off its new culinary Masters Class series tomorrow (Thursday, July 23) at 6:30pm with 'Summer Seafood Secrets' — an intimate, hands-on cooking evening for seafood enthusiasts; the series is planned to run regularly through the fall, and seats are limited so book directly with the restaurant.

stories.headline: Montclair History Center Kids' Summer Workshops Start July 27 — Hands-On Morning Programs at 9am Through August
stories.summary: The Montclair History Center (108 Orange Road) launches its next round of hands-on kids' summer workshops on Monday July 27 and Tuesday July 28 at 9am — part of an ongoing summer series with activities suitable for all ages including tweens, continuing through August; free or low-cost, details at montclairnjusa.org.

stories.headline: PSS 7 Final Preview: Jacob Rodriguez vs. Vagner Rocha in Miami This Thursday — ADCC Stakes High for Both
stories.summary: Jacob Rodriguez steps back onto the mat Thursday (July 24) at Karate Combat's Pit Submission Series 7 in Miami for his return from a 17-month hiatus, facing veteran Vagner Rocha in a bout laden with family history — Rodriguez submitted Vagner's son Achilles by RNC at ADCC 2024 — with significant ADCC Krakow seeding implications for both men eight weeks before the September 12-13 world championship.

stories.headline: ADCC 66kg, 77kg and 88kg Slots Open After Three Champs Withdraw — Krakow Bracket Continues to Take Shape
stories.summary: With Diogo Reis (66kg), Mica Galvao (77kg), and Giancarlo Bodoni (88kg) officially off the September 12-13 ADCC World Championship roster, the promotion is working to finalize replacement invitees for each vacated seed — potentially reshuffling all three weight classes and opening title-shot opportunities for unseeded alternates who impressed at the 2026 regional trial circuit.

stories.headline: F2W 322 Fresno This Saturday July 26 — Submission Grappling Circuit Rolls On With ADCC Krakow Eight Weeks Out
stories.summary: Fight to Win 322 heads to Fresno on Saturday July 26 with a full no-gi card, keeping the weekly pre-ADCC grappling calendar intact as the circuit enters its final stretch before the September 12-13 World Championship; the promotion also confirmed its first-ever Brazil event is in the works, expanding its footprint ahead of what is shaping up to be grappling's biggest commercial year.

stories.headline: Atletico Madrid Pre-Season Begins Today — World Cup Players on Extended Rest, Stockholm Friendly August 1 the Target Date
stories.summary: Atletico Madrid's 2026-27 pre-season training kicked off today (July 21) with a reduced group, as Spanish champions Baena, Grimaldo, Pubill, and Llorente plus Argentine finalists Alvarez, Almada, G. Simeone, and Molina remain on mandatory post-World-Cup rest; the full squad is expected to assemble by August 1 ahead of the Stockholm pre-season friendly against Manchester United at Strawberry Arena.

stories.headline: Besiktas Enter Salah Race With First Formal Offer as Atletico Madrid Work on Salary Package
stories.summary: Turkish giants Besiktas have made the first formal offer for free-agent Mohamed Salah, entering a race that now includes Atletico Madrid, Saudi Pro League clubs, and reported interest from other European sides; Atletico are working to construct a salary package competitive enough to beat Saudi offers, believing Champions League football under Simeone is the key differentiator for the Egyptian captain.

stories.headline: Atletico 2026-27 Squad Crystallizes: Grimaldo and Hjulmand In, Sorloth to Juventus, Salah the Last Missing Piece
stories.summary: As pre-season begins, Atletico Madrid's 2026-27 shape is coming into focus: confirmed new arrivals Alejandro Grimaldo (LB, 22M euros) and Morten Hjulmand (DM, 40M euros) fill two key positions; Alexander Sorloth's move to Juventus is near with clubs around 5M euros apart on a ~35M euro fee; and Julian Alvarez stays after the 150M euro Real Madrid rejection — leaving Mohamed Salah as the one remaining transfer target before La Liga kicks off in late August.

stories.headline: Alphabet and Tesla Headline Massive Earnings Week — S&P 500 Blended Growth 24.7%; AAPL Opens at $331.98
stories.summary: The busiest week of Q2 2026 earnings season opens with Alphabet (GOOGL) reporting Wednesday after close — analysts project $2.87 EPS on $116.8-120.2B revenue with Google Cloud up 63% YoY — and Tesla Thursday; S&P 500 blended earnings growth stands at 24.7% with 87% of early reporters beating estimates, lifting VTI near its 52-week high as AAPL opens at $331.98 today, nine days from its own July 30 earnings report.

stories.headline: NJ 30-Year Refinance Rate Jumps to 7.02% — Up From 6.65% Last Week as Bond Markets Price Fewer Fed Cuts
stories.summary: New Jersey's average 30-year fixed mortgage refinance rate has risen to 7.02% (15-year: 6.04%), reversing last week's 6.65% level as bond markets price fewer near-term Fed rate cuts; NJ homeowners eyeing a refinance should monitor closely — a softer-than-expected Alphabet or Apple earnings print this week or next could pull rates back, while waiting risks further increases if economic data stays hot.

stories.headline: SPOT: 14 Days to August 4 Earnings — Jefferies Projects Steady Quarter; AI Remixing Timeline Is the Key Catalyst
stories.summary: With Spotify's Q2 report 14 days away (August 4, before market open), Jefferies projects a steady print — 33.1% gross margin and 17M net new MAUs — but views the quarter as unlikely to be 'narrative-changing'; the stock's path to its $678 analyst consensus price target (37% upside from ~$494) depends almost entirely on management providing a concrete rollout timeline for the AI remixing feature at the earnings call.

stories.headline: Colson Whitehead at Montclair State TOMORROW (July 22) — Two-Time Pulitzer Winner Presents Final Harlem Trilogy Novel
stories.summary: Two-time Pulitzer Prize winner Colson Whitehead appears at MSU's Memorial Auditorium (1 Normal Ave, Montclair) tomorrow July 22 at 7pm to discuss 'Cool Machine,' the conclusion to his Harlem Trilogy, in conversation with book critic Kate Tuttle; tickets are $45.99 and include a signed copy of the novel, with a post-show signing to follow — book now at tickettailor.com.

stories.headline: Sourland Mountain Festival This Saturday July 25 in Ringoes — Family Scavenger Hunt, Live Music, Food at Unionville Vineyards
stories.summary: The 2026 Sourland Mountain Festival returns Saturday July 25 (3pm-dusk) at Unionville Vineyards, 9 Rocktown Road, East Amwell Township (~40 min from Montclair), with live music from regional bands, a family scavenger hunt, and local food and craft beer; only 1,000 tickets available, advance purchase recommended at sourlandmountainfest.com.

stories.headline: Montclair Jazz Soundcheck Monday July 28: Joel Ross' Good Vibes Honors Chicago at Lackawanna Plaza — Free, 6-10pm
stories.summary: The Montclair Jazz Festival's free weekly Soundcheck Series continues Monday July 28 with Grammy-nominated vibraphonist Joel Ross and his quartet Good Vibes performing at Lackawanna Station (1 Lackawanna Plaza), 6-10pm — part of the festival's 2026 'American Jazz Cities' theme honoring Chicago; free and open to all, no registration required.

stories.headline: ADCC Krakow Loses Three Defending Division Champions — Diogo Reis, Mica Galvao, and Giancarlo Bodoni Officially Out
stories.summary: ADCC has confirmed the removal of three sitting division champions from its Krakow 2026 roster: Diogo Reis (66kg), Mica Galvao (77kg), and Giancarlo Bodoni (88kg), alongside West Coast Trials winner Elder Cruz — reshuffling three weight classes and opening significant bracket opportunities for unseeded grapplers eight weeks before the September 12–13 event.

stories.headline: Grappling Bulletin: IBJJF No-Gi Worlds on the Calendar, UFC BJJ Series Plans Event 8, F2W Goes to Brazil
stories.summary: FloGrappling's July 20 weekly bulletin highlights the sport's explosive 2026 growth: IBJJF No-Gi Worlds registration has opened for a late-year date; the UFC BJJ series — which launched in January with 14 events planned for 2026 — is already scheduling event 8; and Fight to Win is staging its first-ever Brazilian show, signaling grappling's global commercial reach.

stories.headline: Post-World Cup: Submission Wrestling Enters Final Eight-Week ADCC Sprint With Clean Calendar
stories.summary: With the FIFA World Cup complete and global sports attention returning to niche disciplines, the grappling scene begins its final eight-week push to ADCC Krakow (September 12–13) — headlined by Pit Submission Series 7 this Thursday (July 24) and F2W 322 Fresno on Saturday (July 25) before full training-camp mode begins for September.

stories.headline: Spain Wins 2026 FIFA World Cup 1-0 Over Argentina — Ferran Torres Scores in 106th Minute at MetLife
stories.summary: Substitute Ferran Torres drove in an 8-yard finish in the 106th minute to give Spain a 1-0 extra-time victory over Argentina in the World Cup Final at MetLife Stadium (12 miles from Montclair), after Enzo Fernández was sent off in stoppage time; La Roja dominated with 1.94 expected goals to Argentina's 0.20, and Spain becomes the first nation to hold both the men's and women's World Cups simultaneously — Messi's record 25-goal tournament ends without a second title.

stories.headline: Atletico's Post-Final Rebuild: Grimaldo (€22M) and Hjulmand (€40M) Confirmed; Salah Now Top Target to Replace Griezmann
stories.summary: With the World Cup complete and players returning, Atletico's summer transfer picture crystallizes: left-back Alejandro Grimaldo (from Bayer Leverkusen, €22M, through 2030) and defensive midfielder Morten Hjulmand (from Sporting CP, €40M, through 2031) are both confirmed signings; Simeone's side now pursues free-agent Mohamed Salah as its headline forward to fill the void left by all-time leading scorer Antoine Griezmann (212 goals), who departs for Orlando City MLS.

stories.headline: Atletico 2026-27 Pre-Season: Man United in Stockholm Aug 1, Man City in Seoul Aug 9, La Liga Opener ~Aug 16 vs. Malaga
stories.summary: Atletico Madrid's 2026-27 pre-season fixtures are confirmed: a friendly vs. Manchester United in Stockholm (August 1) and vs. Manchester City in Seoul (August 9), ahead of the La Liga opener against Malaga scheduled around August 16 — potentially pushed to August 23 if World Cup finalists from Spain and Argentina need extended recovery time after Sunday's final.

stories.headline: Big Earnings Week: ~80 S&P 500 Companies Report; Alphabet Wednesday, Intel Thursday Are Key AI Sentiment Reads
stories.summary: The week of July 21–24 is Q2 earnings season's most concentrated stretch, with roughly 80 S&P 500 companies reporting and blended EPS growth running at 23% above prior-year levels; Alphabet reports Wednesday ($2.90 EPS consensus, +25.5% YoY on $116.9B revenue) and Intel reports Thursday — both will shape near-term sentiment on AI CapEx spending, the key macro driver for tech, VTI, and broad market momentum heading into Apple's July 30 print.

stories.headline: AAPL Climbs to $333-334, 10 Days to July 30 Earnings — $1.88 EPS Consensus, Record $31B Services, $5T Cap in Sight
stories.summary: Apple opens the week near $333–334 (up 20% YTD), 10 days from its July 30 Q3 FY2026 earnings; analysts project $1.88 EPS (+20% YoY) on $108.9B revenue (+15.7%), building on the record $30.98B in services revenue reported last quarter — a print at roughly $340 would make Apple only the second company after Nvidia to cross $5 trillion in market cap.

stories.headline: SPOT 15 Days to August 4 Q2 Earnings: Jefferies Projects 'Steady' Print; AI Remixing Timeline Is the Key Catalyst
stories.summary: Spotify shares near $494 are 15 days from their August 4 Q2 earnings call (before market open), with Jefferies projecting a 'steady' but not 'narrative-changing' report — 33.1% gross margin, 17M net new MAU additions; investor focus will center on management's timeline for the AI remixing feature, viewed as the next major re-rating catalyst for SPOT.

stories.headline: Mikki + Al's Noshery and Plum Bakery Close as Chef Natalie Lee Retires After 40+ Years in Montclair Kitchens
stories.summary: Two beloved Montclair sister establishments — Mikki + Al's Noshery and Plum Bakery — have permanently closed following Chef Natalie Lee's announced retirement after more than four decades in professional kitchens; the closures leave a gap in the neighborhood dining and pastry scene as summer regulars look for alternatives.

stories.headline: FIFA Sells 'Piece of the Pitch' MetLife Turf Packs ($450–$3,000) — NJ Gov. Sherrill Demands State Gets a Cut
stories.summary: Following Spain's World Cup Final victory at MetLife Stadium, FIFA is selling certified grass from the match field in acrylic cases — Foundation edition ($450) to Hero edition ($3,000, with gold-etched ticket, mini match ball, and crystal trophy) — available at FIFA's shop with US and Europe shipping; separately, Governor Madeleine Sherrill is publicly pressing FIFA to share revenue with New Jersey, arguing the state hosted the event and deserves a cut of merchandise proceeds.

stories.headline: Montclair Historic Preservation Commission Reviews Aug. 20 Plan to Demolish Nicolo's Bakery Block on Baldwin Street
stories.summary: A proposed mixed-use development at 6 and 12 Baldwin Street in Montclair would demolish both buildings — including the longtime home of Nicolo's Bakery, a community institution — with the Historic Preservation Commission reviewing the plans on August 20; residents concerned about losing the bakery have until the public meeting to submit comments on the project.

stories.headline: F2W 321 San Diego Wraps Last Night; F2W 322 Fresno This Saturday — California No-Gi Double-Header Complete
stories.summary: Fight to Win completed its San Diego stop (F2W 321) last night as results filter in, closing out the California portion of the pre-ADCC summer circuit; F2W 322 heads to Fresno this coming Saturday July 25, keeping weekly no-gi action on the calendar with six weeks remaining before the September 12–13 ADCC World Championship in Krakow.

stories.headline: 'Two Siblings of Champions' Round Out UFC BJJ 2 Undercard — Full 10-Fight Free Card Set for July 31
stories.summary: UFC has published its complete 10-bout card for UFC BJJ 2 (July 31, free on YouTube at 8pm ET), adding undercard fighters described as siblings of existing champions — injecting family-rivalry storylines alongside the main events: welterweight champion Andrew Tackett vs. Renato Canuto and Mason Fowler vs. David Garmo for the inaugural UFC BJJ light heavyweight title.

stories.headline: Seven Weeks to ADCC Krakow — The Divisional Races Beyond the Duarte-Simões Superfight
