stories.summary: With seven weeks until the September 12–13 ADCC World Championship at Tauron Arena Kraków, the headline Kaynan Duarte vs. Yuri Simões superfight is set but divisional races remain wide open — particularly in women's -60kg where Helena Crevar enters as an overwhelming favorite after extending her submission streak to 21, and in -66kg where 14-year-old Joslyn Molina faces a world-class adult field.

stories.headline: World Cup Final Day — Spain vs. Argentina Kicks Off 3pm ET at MetLife: Your Complete Watch Guide
stories.summary: The 2026 FIFA World Cup Final is today at MetLife Stadium (12 miles from Montclair), kicking off at 3pm ET on Fox; for local fans, Varitage Brew Works (Bloomfield) has an outdoor LED wall, Egan & Sons and Montclair Brewery are screening the match, and the free FIFA Fan Festival at Liberty State Park opens at 9am — plus NJ Transit runs Meadowlands trains from Penn Station every 15-20 minutes from 11:30am.

stories.headline: Atlético President Confirms Álvarez Stays — Real Madrid's €150M Bid Rejected; 'He Will Play for Us Next Season'
stories.summary: Atlético Madrid president Enrique Cerezo officially confirmed Sunday that Julián Álvarez will remain at the club for 2026-27 after the board rejected a €150M bid from Real Madrid — the highest reported offer yet — following earlier refusals of Barcelona and Arsenal bids; the statement makes clear the €500M release clause is the only exit route for the 26-year-old Argentine.

stories.headline: England Beat France 2-1 in World Cup Third-Place Classic — Bronze for Three Lions, Mbappé Ends Without a Trophy
stories.summary: England claimed World Cup bronze by beating France 2-1 in a match broadcasters called an 'instant classic' — ending Kylian Mbappé's 2026 campaign without a winner's medal and giving England their best finish at a World Cup since their 1966 triumph; the result set the stage for today's Spain-Argentina final at MetLife.

stories.headline: Apple Overtakes Nvidia as World's Most Valuable Company — $4.88T Market Cap, 11 Days to July 30 Earnings
stories.summary: Apple closed Friday as the world's most valuable company at $4.88T market cap, ending Nvidia's near-year-long reign as investors reassessed AI infrastructure spending risk; AAPL is up 20% YTD near $327-330 and has 11 days until its July 30 Q3 earnings report where analysts project $1.88 EPS on ~$108B revenue — a potential catalyst to push the cap past $5 trillion.

stories.headline: Apple Music Raises Individual Plan to $11.99 — First Price Hike in Four Years, Citing Rising Licensing Costs
stories.summary: Apple Music raised its individual subscription from $10.99 to $11.99 per month effective July 17, the first price increase in nearly four years; the family plan rose to $19.99, student to $6.99, and Apple One bundles adjusted upward — narrowing the gap with Spotify Premium ($12.99) and adding a potential competitive headwind for SPOT ahead of its August 4 earnings.

stories.headline: Week Ahead: Markets Open Monday Near Highs — AAPL Pre-Earnings, VTI Steady, NJ 30-Year Refinance at 6.65%
stories.summary: US markets open Monday July 21 with S&P 500 near 7,543 and VTI around $371-373 after Friday's rebound; AAPL enters a pre-earnings quiet period (11 days to July 30 results) and SPOT is 16 days from its August 4 earnings; New Jersey's 30-year fixed refinance rate holds near 6.65% — still a viable window for homeowners who locked in near the 2023 peak, and the new $40K SALT cap adds further incentive to review 2026 tax positioning.

stories.headline: LuminoCity Dino Safari at Freehold Raceway Mall Through August 16 — 70+ Roaring Dinosaurs, From $20
stories.summary: LuminoCity's Dino Safari Festival runs nightly at Freehold Raceway Mall (3710 US-9, Freehold, ~45 min from Montclair) through August 16, featuring 70+ life-size illuminated dinosaurs, a 25-foot Volcano Bounce Zone, and a neon DJ booth; evening hours are 5–9:30pm Sun-Thu and 5–10pm Fri-Sat, with general admission from $20 (children under 3 free) and a 25% early-bird discount available.

stories.headline: Montclair Planning Board Seeks Public Input on 2026 Master Plan — Four Community Meetings Through August
stories.summary: Montclair's Planning Board is hosting four public meetings this July and August for residents to weigh in on the township's 10-year master plan reexamination, covering land use, housing, transportation, and economic development priorities; all residents are welcome regardless of ward, and feedback will shape the draft report presented to the board in fall 2026.

stories.headline: How to Train Your Dragon Closes State Theatre NJ Free Summer Series July 28 — Reserve Now at stnj.org
stories.summary: The final film in State Theatre NJ's free Summer Movies Series is How to Train Your Dragon (DreamWorks, 2010) on Tuesday July 28 at 10:30am and 6:30pm in New Brunswick, with movie-themed crafts at 5:30pm before the evening show; this is the last free screening of the summer and follows Zootopia 2 (this Tuesday, July 21) — free tickets require advance reservation at stnj.org.

stories.headline: Jacob Rodriguez vs. Vagner Rocha Set for Pit Submission Series July 24 — Family Rivalry Adds Stakes to Return
stories.summary: Jacob Rodriguez's comeback from a 17-month absence will be against Vagner Rocha at Pit Submission Series 7 on July 24 — a bout loaded with intergenerational history: Vagner fought Jacob's brother Nicky Rodriguez in 2023, and Jacob beat Vagner's son Achilles by rear-naked choke at ADCC 2024; the result will be a key form guide seven weeks before ADCC Krakow.

stories.headline: F2W 321 Tonight in San Diego, F2W 322 in Fresno July 25 — Summer No-Gi Season Hits Full Swing
stories.summary: Fight to Win rolls through California with F2W 321 in San Diego tonight (July 18) and F2W 322 in Fresno next Saturday (July 25), maintaining its weekly showcase for elite no-gi talent as the grappling scene enters its final pre-ADCC Krakow push.

stories.headline: Eight Weeks to ADCC Krakow: 128-Person Field Finalized, All Divisional Storylines in Focus
stories.summary: With the full ADCC 2026 roster locked and eight weeks until the September 12-13 World Championship, the key storylines are set: Kaynan Duarte vs. Yuri Simoes in the vacated absolute superfight, Joslyn Molina (14) making history in -65kg, and Gabi Garcia returning for a seventh ADCC — all at Tauron Arena Krakow.

stories.headline: World Cup Final Sunday 3pm ET: Spain and Argentina Confirm Starting Lineups — Messi's Last Dance at MetLife
stories.summary: Spain's 4-3-3 will feature Lamine Yamal, Mikel Oyarzabal, and Alex Baena up front with Rodri, Fabian Ruiz, and Dani Olmo in midfield; Argentina counter with Messi, Julian Alvarez, and Giuliano Simeone attacking and Mac Allister, Enzo Fernandez, and Paredes behind — kick-off Sunday 3pm ET on Fox at MetLife Stadium.

stories.headline: Atletico CEO Slams All Alvarez Exit Routes: 'We Won't Accept 200M Euros' — Hardline Stand on Eve of World Cup Final
stories.summary: Atletico Madrid CEO Miguel Angel Gil confirmed Friday the club will not sell Julian Alvarez this summer for any price — rejecting reported 100M+ euro offers from both Barcelona and Arsenal and restating the 500M euro release clause stands — a bombshell reversal that ends the transfer saga just hours before Alvarez starts in Sunday's Final.

stories.headline: Messi's Last World Cup by the Numbers: 8 Goals, 25 Career WC Goals, 4th Final at Age 39
stories.summary: Heading into Sunday's Final, Lionel Messi leads the tournament with 8 goals and extends his own record for all-time World Cup goals to 25 across four tournaments, becoming the first player to reach four World Cup Finals — at 39, this is almost certainly his farewell, with Argentina aiming to become the first back-to-back champions since Brazil in 1962.

stories.headline: Markets Rebound Friday: Nasdaq +0.9%, S&P 500 +0.38% to 7,543 — AAPL Near $327 Heading Into July 30 Earnings
stories.summary: U.S. stocks closed the week on a positive note Friday as the Nasdaq gained 0.9% to 26,107 and the S&P 500 rose 0.38% to 7,543, largely recovering from Thursday's chip selloff; VTI held firm in the $370-373 range and AAPL consolidated near $327 — just 4% below the approximately $340 level that would push Apple's market cap past $5 trillion ahead of the July 30 Q3 earnings report.

stories.headline: NJ Property Tax Bills in Mailboxes by July 31 — File PAS-1 Now for September 15 ANCHOR Payments
stories.summary: New Jersey municipalities must mail 2026 final and 2027 preliminary property tax bills by July 31; homeowners who have not yet filed the combined PAS-1 application (ANCHOR, Senior Freeze, and Stay NJ) should do so immediately — the portal opened July 1 and ANCHOR direct deposits begin September 15, worth up to $1,750 with the senior bonus.

stories.headline: NJ Mansion Tax Now Hits Sellers of $2M+ Homes — Graduated Rates From 2% to 3.5% Now in Effect
stories.summary: Under New Jersey's FY2026 budget, the mansion tax now falls on sellers with a graduated structure: 2% for homes sold at $2M-$2.5M, rising to 3.5% for properties above $3.5M — a meaningful cost shift for high-equity homeowners and investors weighing a 2026 sale in Essex County and other high-value NJ markets.

stories.headline: Zootopia 2 Free at State Theatre NJ This Tuesday July 21 — Two Showings, Reserve Tickets Now at stnj.org
stories.summary: State Theatre New Jersey in New Brunswick screens Zootopia 2 for free on Tuesday July 21 at 10:30am and 6:30pm, with movie-themed crafts starting at 5:30pm before the evening show — the penultimate film in the summer series before How to Train Your Dragon closes it on July 28; free tickets require advance reservation at stnj.org.

stories.headline: 'Best in Show' Free Outdoor Movie at Anderson Park July 26 — Montclair Film Series, Bring the Dog
stories.summary: Montclair Film's Movie Night Under the Stars screens Christopher Guest's 'Best in Show' (2000) free at Anderson Park (274 Bellevue Ave, Montclair) on Sunday July 26 at 7pm, with a dog parade before the film — a laid-back family evening in the park; registration recommended at montclairfilm.org, rain date is August 2.

stories.headline: Montclair Flea Returns July 25-26 at Lackawanna Plaza — Art, Vintage, Food, 11am-5pm Both Days
stories.summary: The Montclair Flea's next edition runs Saturday-Sunday July 25-26 at 1 Lackawanna Plaza (11am-5pm), featuring curated vendors with art, vintage goods, and local food — a rain-or-shine family outing in downtown Montclair that pairs well with a post-World-Cup-Final lunch or dinner on Church Street.

stories.headline: Crevar Extends to 21 Straight Submissions at ONE Inner Circle 22, Stops Clymer in Bangkok
stories.summary: Helena Crevar picked up her 21st consecutive submission victory at ONE Inner Circle 22 in Bangkok, finishing Paige Ivette Clymer by inside heel hook at Lumpinee Stadium to complete her pre-ADCC season with eight weeks remaining before the September 12-13 World Championship in Krakow.

stories.headline: ADCC Krakow Roster Finalized: Gabi Garcia Returns for Women's Heavyweight, Andrey and Gamrot Complete 128-Person Field
stories.summary: The full 128-person ADCC 2026 World Championship bracket is confirmed for Krakow with notable late additions: submission grappling legend Gabi Garcia accepted a surprise women's heavyweight invite, while Fabricio Andrey (66kg) and UFC veteran Mateusz Gamrot (77kg) fill the final men's slots despite the headline absences of three defending champions.

stories.headline: UFC BJJ 2 Grows to Two-Title Event July 31: Fowler vs. Garmo Added for Inaugural Light Heavyweight Championship
stories.summary: The July 31 UFC BJJ 2 card expanded to a double-championship event with Mason Fowler facing David Garmo for the first-ever light heavyweight belt alongside the welterweight main event between champion Andrew Tackett and Renato Canuto; both title bouts stream live and free on UFC's YouTube channel at 8pm ET.

stories.headline: World Cup Final Preview: Spain's Record Defense vs. Messi's Last Stand — Sunday 3pm ET at MetLife
stories.summary: Spain enter Sunday's MetLife Final as marginal favorites with a tournament-record six clean sheets and just one goal conceded in seven games; Argentina counter with Lionel Messi widely expected to be playing his last World Cup match, and the resilience of a team that came from 1-0 down to beat England in added time — back-to-back champions Argentina seek what would be a feat unseen since Brazil in 1962.

stories.headline: Arsenal's Final Push: Gunners in Direct Talks to Sign Álvarez Before July 20 Pre-Season as Clock Runs Out
stories.summary: Arsenal sporting director Berta is in direct talks to finalize a deal for Julián Álvarez before the Gunners' July 20 pre-season kicks off — Atlético Madrid have green-lit the sale to Arsenal but refuse to deal with Barcelona (a La Liga rival), giving Arsenal the path to a ~£100M signing even as Álvarez himself reportedly prefers a Barcelona move that Atlético won't allow.

stories.headline: La Roja Lands in Montclair: Team Spain Checks Into MC Hotel Ahead of Sunday's World Cup Final
stories.summary: After flying from Dallas overnight, Team Spain settled into the MC Hotel on Valley Road in Montclair — the World Cup's go-to base for MetLife-area teams — with fans lining up outside for glimpses of Lamine Yamal and teammates; the hotel's Allegory bar and Splendid Rooftop are closed to the public through Sunday July 19 for Spain's full venue buyout.

stories.headline: Chip Selloff Hits Markets Thursday — Nasdaq Falls 1.47%, VTI Retreats as TSMC Capex Hike Rattles AI Investors
stories.summary: Stocks fell Thursday after TSMC raised its 2026 capex forecast to $60-64B (up from $52-56B), stoking concerns about AI spending sustainability; the Nasdaq dropped 1.47% to 25,882 and the S&P 500 fell 0.51% to 7,534, dragging VTI back from near its 52-week high of $374.70 — AAPL held relatively firm near $327 heading into the July 30 Q3 earnings report.

stories.headline: SPOT Climbs to $493.95 as August 4 Earnings Approach — 785% EPS Growth Targeted, 37% Analyst Price Upside
stories.summary: Spotify shares rose 2.26% to $493.95 as the August 4 Q2 earnings date draws closer, with consensus expecting EPS of $3.29 — up 785% year-over-year — and revenue of $5.6B; the analyst price target consensus of $678 implies roughly 37% upside from current levels, with the call expected to update on AI remixing capabilities and monthly active user trajectory.

stories.headline: OBBBA's New $40K SALT Cap Now Effective for 2026: NJ Homeowners Who Itemize Can Deduct Full Property Tax for First Time Since 2017
stories.summary: The One Big Beautiful Budget Act (OBBBA) raised the federal SALT deduction cap from $10,000 to $40,000 (effective 2025-2029), letting most NJ homeowners who itemize fully deduct their state and local taxes on federal returns — potentially saving hundreds to thousands annually; the deduction phases out above $500K MAGI and reverts to $10,000 in 2030 without further Congressional action.

stories.headline: World Cup Final Watch in Montclair This Sunday: Varitage Brew Works Takes Party Outdoors With Giant LED Wall
stories.summary: For the best local World Cup Final watch party Sunday, Varitage Brew Works (58 Washington St., Bloomfield) is moving to the outdoor Washington Street Rock Lot with a double-sided LED wall; within Montclair itself, Egan & Sons, Montclair Brewery, and Just Jake's are all screening the 3pm ET Spain vs. Argentina final — arrive early for seating.

stories.headline: Rutgers 'Watch Party at The Yard' for World Cup Final July 19 — Free, Family-Friendly in New Brunswick
stories.summary: Rutgers University is hosting a free World Cup Final watch party at The Yard in New Brunswick on Sunday July 19 (3pm ET) — about 25 minutes from Montclair with ample parking and NJ Transit access from Penn Station; a great family-friendly option if Montclair bars fill up for the Spain vs. Argentina final.

stories.headline: FilmOneFest Tomorrow Night: Outdoor Short Films With Manhattan Skyline in Jersey City, July 18 6pm–11pm
stories.summary: Saturday July 18, FilmOneFest hosts an outdoor short film showcase in Jersey City (6pm–11pm) with a Manhattan skyline backdrop — a great movie night for families about 30 minutes from Montclair near Liberty State Park, and a perfect complement to World Cup Final weekend.

stories.headline: ONE Inner Circle 22 TONIGHT: Helena Crevar Brings 20-Match Submission Streak vs. Paige Ivette Clymer in Bangkok
stories.summary: Women's world #1 pound-for-pound Helena Crevar (355-7, 315 submission wins, 20 consecutive finishes) takes on ADCC West Coast Trials winner Paige Ivette Clymer in a 10-minute openweight grappling match at Lumpinee Stadium tonight — her final competitive appearance before ADCC Krakow September 12-13.

stories.headline: Musumeci-Mitchell Grappling Match Still Homeless at 8 Weeks — Both Committed, No Promotion Has Stepped Up
stories.summary: Nearly two months after Bryce Mitchell challenged Mikey Musumeci and the flyweight champion publicly accepted, no organization has agreed to host the crossover grappling bout; both fighters remain publicly committed, but the match is stuck in limbo with the ADCC Krakow prep calendar filling up around them.

stories.headline: UFC BJJ 2 Confirmed July 31: Champion Andrew Tackett Defends Against Renato Canuto in Growing No-Gi Series
stories.summary: UFC's no-gi grappling series returns July 31 with champion Andrew Tackett putting his belt on the line against Brazilian submission grappling veteran Renato Canuto — the second event in a planned 14-card 2026 schedule that's rapidly positioning itself alongside ADCC and Polaris as a major destination for elite grapplers.

stories.headline: Argentina Stun England 2-1 With Late Comeback — Messi Assists Both Goals, Final is Spain vs. Argentina July 19 at MetLife
stories.summary: Lionel Messi assisted both goals as Argentina overturned a 1-0 deficit in the final seven minutes — Enzo Fernandez's 85th-minute strike and Lautaro Martinez's 92nd-minute header — to set up a World Cup Final against Spain at MetLife Stadium on July 19, in what may be Messi's last World Cup match.

stories.headline: World Cup Final Preview: Spain (1 Goal Conceded) vs. Argentina at MetLife July 19 — Yamal vs. Messi Is the Dream Subplot
stories.summary: Spain — who conceded just once in seven games — are slight favorites over defending champions Argentina in Sunday's 3pm ET final at MetLife Stadium; Lamine Yamal, who publicly dreamed of facing Messi in a final, gets his wish, while Messi's record 21 World Cup goals and Argentina's late-game resilience make the outcome far from certain.

stories.headline: Álvarez Wants Barcelona but Atlético Won't Sell to LaLiga Rivals — Arsenal Now the Most Realistic Destination
stories.summary: With Argentina's World Cup over, the Álvarez transfer crystallized: the striker prefers Barcelona but Atlético categorically refuses to sell to a domestic rival, making Arsenal — who are pushing to finalize a deal before pre-season begins next week — the most realistic path despite Álvarez's reluctance to move to England.

stories.headline: AAPL Hits 15th 2026 ATH at $327.50, Up 20% YTD — Analysts Say $340 Makes Apple Second $5T Company After Nvidia
stories.summary: Apple shares closed Wednesday at a new all-time high of $327.50 — up 20% year-to-date and the 15th record close of 2026 — with the market cap approaching $5 trillion; analysts say a move to ~$340 (less than 4% away) would make Apple only the second company after Nvidia to cross the $5T threshold, with July 30 Q3 earnings as the next major catalyst.

stories.headline: Spotify Q2 Earnings Expected Monday July 20 Before Open — EPS $3.29 Target, SPOT Near $480
stories.summary: Multiple financial calendars point to Monday July 20 as Spotify's Q2 earnings date (before market open), with consensus expecting EPS of $3.29 — a 785% year-over-year jump — alongside updates on AI remixing features and monthly active user trajectory; SPOT trades near $480, recovering from year-to-date lows, with the analyst consensus target at $678 (~41% upside).

stories.headline: VTI Tracks Near 52-Week High $374.70 on AAPL-Led Rally; NJ 30-Year Refinance Holds at 6.65%
stories.summary: The Vanguard Total Stock Market ETF trades near its 52-week high of $374.70 as Apple's record week lifts the full market alongside continued broad breadth; New Jersey's 30-year fixed refinance rate holds at approximately 6.65% (15-year: 5.86%), keeping a refinance window open for the 52% of NJ homeowners who are equity-rich.

stories.headline: MM by Morimoto Reservations Now Live on Resy — Book Immediately for Iron Chef's Montclair Opening July 31
stories.summary: Reservations for MM by Morimoto at 193 Glenridge Ave opened today on Resy for the July 31 dinner launch — the 12,779-sq-ft Iron Chef Masaharu Morimoto concept features A5 Wagyu, an omakase bar, and premium fish flown from Japan; book now as Montclair's most anticipated 2026 restaurant opening is expected to fill within hours.

stories.headline: World Cup Final Sunday at MetLife 3pm ET — Free Watch Options: Newark Fan Village, American Dream, NJ Transit Guide
stories.summary: Sunday's World Cup Final (Spain vs. Argentina, 3pm ET on Fox) is 12 miles from Montclair at MetLife Stadium; for fans without tickets ($8,000+), free options include the Newark Fan Village (Ferry Street, Ironbound district, large screen, food hall) and the American Dream Fan Fest across from MetLife — NJ Transit runs enhanced Meadowlands trains from Penn Station from 11:30am every 15-20 minutes.

stories.headline: Shrek: The Musical Opens This Friday July 17 at Algonquin Arts Theatre in Manasquan — Runs Through July 26
stories.summary: The Algonquin Arts Theatre in Manasquan launches Shrek: The Musical this Friday July 17 through July 26 — the fast-paced, laugh-out-loud Broadway adaptation is a great family outing about 45 minutes from Montclair, pairing well with a Jersey Shore beach day or World Cup Final watch plans this weekend.

stories.headline: ONE Inner Circle 22 Friday: Crevar vs. Clymer Is a Keenan-vs-Danaher Coaching Clash Nine Weeks Before ADCC
stories.summary: ONE Championship has published a full profile of debutant Paige Ivette Clymer ahead of Friday's submission grappling match against Helena Crevar, describing her as a relentless Legion AJJ pressure passer trained by Keenan Cornelius — setting up a philosophically fascinating Keenan vs. Danaher coaching matchup nine weeks before both women compete at ADCC Krakow.

stories.headline: ADCC Krakow Ticket Sales Near 4 Per Day; Duarte-Simoes Superfight Is Now the Event's Clear Top Billing
stories.summary: With three defending champions absent, the Ruotolo twins out, and Gordon Ryan retired, the 15,030-seat Tauron Arena Kraków remains far from sold out ahead of the September 12-13 World Championships; the Kaynan Duarte vs. Yuri Simoes openweight superfight for Gordon Ryan's vacated title and 14-year-old Joslyn Molina's -65kg appearance are the event's most compelling drawing cards.

stories.headline: Jacob Rodriguez Returns to Competition July 24 After 17-Month Hiatus at Pit Submission Series
stories.summary: Former ADCC silver medalist Jacob Rodriguez will end a 17-month absence from professional grappling on July 24 at the Pit Submission Series — a notable return arriving just seven weeks before ADCC Krakow, where he is expected to compete.

stories.headline: Spain 2-0 France: Yamal Draw Earns Penalty, Porro Finishes — La Roja in First World Cup Final Since 2010
stories.summary: Lamine Yamal drew a Digne foul for Oyarzabal's 22nd-minute penalty, then Pedro Porro added a 58th-minute strike as Spain dominated France 2-0 at AT&T Stadium on Monday — sending La Roja to the July 19 MetLife Final for the first time since 2010 and ending Mbappé's tournament without a showpiece.

stories.headline: England vs. Argentina SF Today 3pm ET in Atlanta: Messi's 21 World Cup Goals vs. Kane — MetLife Spot on the Line
stories.summary: The second 2026 World Cup semifinal kicks off today (3pm ET on Fox) at Mercedes-Benz Stadium in Atlanta, with Lionel Messi — sole holder of the all-time World Cup goals record at 21 — leading Argentina against Harry Kane and England, who seek their first Final appearance since 1966 and would face Spain at MetLife on Saturday.

stories.headline: Atlético Transfer Desk: Arsenal Enters Álvarez Race — Formal Talks Expected This Week as Argentina's WC Run Ends Today
stories.summary: The Hard Tackle reports Atlético Madrid is open to selling Julián Álvarez to Arsenal, making the Premier League club the third major suitor alongside Barcelona and PSG; with Argentina's World Cup run ending today in the semifinal, formal transfer negotiations are expected to begin imminently with the fee target in the €130-150M range.

stories.headline: VTI Near $372 Midweek as Warsh Enters Day 2 of Fed Testimony; July 30 Apple Earnings Now Top Market Catalyst
stories.summary: VTI holds near $372 — close to its 52-week high of $374.70 — as new Fed Chair Kevin Warsh enters the second day of his inaugural congressional testimony; with June CPI digested and bank earnings mostly in, Apple's July 30 Q3 print is now the single most closely-watched near-term catalyst for both tech and the broader market.

stories.headline: AAPL 15 Days to Earnings: Near ATH at $317, China iPhone Shipments Up 20-25%; Analysts Target $1.88 EPS
stories.summary: Apple shares trade near $317 — modestly below last week's all-time high of $323.45 — as the July 30 Q3 earnings date approaches; analysts project $1.88 EPS (up ~20% YoY) on ~$108.9B revenue, with fresh data showing iPhone China shipments up 20-25% YoY in Q2 adding a positive pre-earnings signal.

stories.headline: NJ 30-Year Refinance Rate Ticks to 6.66% — Still a Viable Window for Homeowners Who Locked In Near 2023's 8% Peak
stories.summary: New Jersey's 30-year fixed refinance rate edged to 6.66% (15-year: 5.86%) as of July 14, slightly above the 6.13% reading earlier in the month; homeowners who financed near the 2023 peak of ~8% still have a meaningful rate-reduction window, though economists caution that a hawkish Fed September pivot could push rates higher.

stories.headline: Act Now: MM by Morimoto Reservations Open TOMORROW on Resy — Montclair's Most Anticipated Restaurant Opening of 2026
stories.summary: Reservations for MM by Morimoto open on Resy tomorrow (July 16), two weeks before the July 31 dinner launch at 193 Glenridge Ave, Montclair — the 200-seat Japanese steakhouse from Iron Chef Masaharu Morimoto features A5 Wagyu, omakase bar, tuna pizza, and fish flown from Japan, and is expected to be one of North Jersey's most in-demand tables.

stories.headline: Final Weekend: Free Outdoor 'Much Ado About Nothing' at Van Vleck House & Gardens Through Saturday July 18
stories.summary: The Studio Players' outdoor Shakespeare production runs through this Saturday July 18 at Van Vleck House & Gardens in Montclair — free admission, no tickets required, and perfect for a summer evening family outing before World Cup Final weekend.

stories.headline: Seussical Jr. at UCPAC July 17-19 — Family Musical This Weekend in Cranford, 20 Minutes From Montclair
stories.summary: CAU Community Players bring Seussical Jr. to the Union County Performing Arts Center in Cranford this Friday through Sunday (July 17-19) — the beloved Dr. Seuss mashup featuring Cat in the Hat and Horton, a great family theater option for kids 10-13 about 20 minutes from Montclair.

stories.headline: ONE: The Inner Circle July 17 Preview — Ruotolo Fights Tetsuka in MMA; Crevar vs. Clymer in Grappling
stories.summary: Thursday's ONE: The Inner Circle card at Lumpinee Stadium in Bangkok features Kade Ruotolo facing Hiroyuki Tetsuka in an MMA clash alongside women's grappling #1 Helena Crevar battling ADCC West Coast Trials winner Paige Ivette Clymer in a submission grappling match.

stories.headline: Joslyn Molina, 14, Confirmed as Youngest-Ever ADCC Worlds Competitor for Krakow September 12-13
stories.summary: Joslyn Molina has officially accepted her invitation to the -65kg division at ADCC 2026 in Krakow, making her the youngest competitor in ADCC history; ADCC amended its minimum-age policy after Molina won bronze at the East Coast Trials competing against adult opponents.

stories.headline: World Cup SF Today: France vs. Spain at AT&T Stadium Dallas (3pm ET) — Winner to MetLife Final July 19
stories.summary: The first 2026 World Cup semifinal kicks off this afternoon with Kylian Mbappé (7 goals) leading France against Lamine Yamal and Spain; the winner earns a spot in Saturday's Final at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, NJ — now five days away.

stories.headline: England vs. Argentina SF Tomorrow July 15, Atlanta (3pm ET): Kane & Bellingham vs. Messi — Final Spot at Stake
stories.summary: Wednesday's second World Cup semifinal at Mercedes-Benz Stadium in Atlanta has England chasing their first Final since 1966, with Kane and Bellingham each on 6 tournament goals, against Messi's Argentina (8 goals, 2022 defending champions); analysts predict a tight, low-scoring affair.

stories.headline: Álvarez Transfer Breakthrough: Apollo Sports Capital Now Backing Sale; Lamine Yamal Made Personal Request
stories.summary: In the biggest shift yet in the Julián Álvarez saga, Atlético's majority shareholders Apollo Sports Capital are increasingly prepared to sanction a transfer to Barcelona, while Lamine Yamal has personally requested the club sign the striker; formal talks resume once Argentina exits the World Cup.

stories.headline: June CPI Released: Headline Falls to ~3.9% on Gas Price Drop; Core Sticky at 2.85% — Warsh Testimony Begins Today
stories.summary: The BLS released June CPI this morning (8:30am ET): headline inflation fell from 4.2% to approximately 3.9% YoY, driven by a ~10% drop in gasoline prices from the US-Iran ceasefire; core CPI held at ~2.85% — well above the Fed's 2% target — with new Chair Kevin Warsh beginning his inaugural congressional testimony today and the July FOMC rate decision now in sharp focus.

stories.headline: AAPL Hits All-Time High $323.45; Citi Raises Target to $365 Ahead of July 30 Earnings
stories.summary: Apple shares set a new intraday all-time high of $323.45 on July 13 (closing at $317.31) after Citi upgraded its price target from $315 to $365, citing AI strategy momentum and continued market share gains; July 30 Q3 earnings are next, where analysts project $1.89 EPS on 14-17% revenue growth.

stories.headline: Spotify Earnings Confirmed August 4 — Later Than Expected; Q1 Beat Showed 761M MAU, Analyst Consensus $678
stories.summary: Spotify's next earnings date is confirmed as August 4 before market open, later than the widely-reported July 29 date; Q1 2026 delivered 761M monthly active users (+12% YoY) and $5.3B revenue (+8%), with soft Q2 guidance weighing on shares despite a $678 analyst consensus target implying ~40% upside.

stories.headline: Ocean County Fair Opens Tomorrow July 15 Through July 19 — Rides, 4-H Animals, Fair Food, $10 Admission
stories.summary: The five-day Ocean County Fair runs July 15-19 at Robert J. Miller Air Park in Berkeley Township (~70 miles from Montclair near Exit 88 GSP), featuring 4-H animal exhibits, carnival rides, live entertainment, and classic fair food; admission is $10 for adults, free for kids under 10.

stories.headline: Where to Watch the World Cup Final July 19 Near Montclair — Free Fan Zone at Liberty State Park, NJ DOT Advisory
stories.summary: For fans unable to pay $8K+ for MetLife tickets, the official FIFA Fan Festival at Liberty State Park in Jersey City (free, opens 9am July 19) is about 20 minutes from Montclair; NJ DOT has issued traffic advisories for the MetLife area with heavy congestion expected around Route 3 from midday Saturday.

stories.headline: Two Free Movies Coming Up: Zootopia 2 at State Theatre NJ July 21; 'Best in Show' at Anderson Park July 26
stories.summary: Next Tuesday July 21, State Theatre NJ in New Brunswick screens Zootopia 2 for free (10:30am and 6:30pm showings, crafts at 5:30pm); Sunday July 26, Montclair Film's 'Movie Night Under the Stars' shows 'Best in Show' free at Anderson Park with a pre-show dog parade — two free family film outings back-to-back.

stories.headline: Polaris 38: Szczecinski Wins Welterweight GP, Sarah Galvao Captures Bantamweight Title
stories.summary: At Polaris 38 on July 11, Mateusz Szczecinski won the welterweight grand prix with three straight wins and a $30,000 prize; Sarah Galvao submitted Zara Di Tofano with an arm-triangle choke to claim the Polaris bantamweight championship.

stories.headline: Kade Ruotolo Returns From Injury to Defend ONE Lightweight Title This Thursday; Crevar–Clymer Also on Card
stories.summary: After withdrawing injured in June, Kade Ruotolo is back to defend his ONE Lightweight Submission Grappling World Title at ONE: The Inner Circle on July 17 in Bangkok — with women's #1 P4P Helena Crevar vs. ADCC West Coast Trials winner Paige Ivette Clymer on the same card.

stories.headline: ADCC Miami Open Concluded July 11 — Last Major North American Qualifier Before Krakow Worlds
stories.summary: The ADCC Miami-Dade Open wrapped Saturday July 11 at the Miami-Dade County Fair & Exposition, awarding 9 world ranking points to first-place finishers in the final major North American qualifier before September's ADCC World Championship in Krakow, Poland.

stories.headline: World Cup SFs Kick Off Tomorrow: France vs. Spain (July 14, Dallas, 3pm ET) and England vs. Argentina (July 15, Atlanta)
stories.summary: The 2026 World Cup semifinals feature the first-ever bracket with FIFA's top-four ranked nations — France (1st) vs. Spain (3rd) at AT&T Stadium tomorrow at 3pm ET on Fox, and Argentina (2nd) vs. England (4th) Wednesday in Atlanta; winners meet at MetLife Stadium, NJ on July 19.

stories.headline: World Cup Final at MetLife July 19: BTS, Shakira, Justin Bieber Halftime Show; Resale From $8K
stories.summary: The 2026 FIFA World Cup Final comes to MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, NJ on July 19 at 3pm ET — 12 miles from Montclair — with a halftime show featuring BTS, Shakira, and Justin Bieber; secondary market resale starts at roughly $8,000–$9,775 for upper-deck seats.

stories.headline: Sørloth Exit From Atlético Expected After Norway's QF Loss to England — Juventus Deal Nears Completion
stories.summary: Alexander Sørloth's Norway fell 2-1 to England in the quarterfinals on July 11 (Jude Bellingham scored twice), ending his World Cup; the result clears the way for his Juventus transfer — Atlético and Juventus remain about €5M apart on a fee of ~€30–35M, with a deal expected imminently.

stories.headline: Álvarez Transfer on Hold Until Argentina's World Cup Run Ends; Barcelona Readying Post-Tournament Bid
stories.summary: With Julián Álvarez still competing with Argentina (SF vs. England, July 15), Barcelona has paused formal transfer negotiations until the World Cup concludes; the club is expected to submit a revised bid close to €130M after Argentina's exit or the final.

stories.headline: Big Week: June CPI Tuesday, Fed Chair Warsh Inaugural Testimony, Q2 Earnings Season Kicks Off
stories.summary: Markets face a critical week with June CPI data Tuesday (consensus +3.8% YoY, down from May's 4.2%), new Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's inaugural congressional testimony Tuesday–Wednesday, and Q2 earnings season launching with JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs, Citigroup, BofA, Netflix, and TSMC all reporting.

stories.headline: Apple Sues OpenAI for AI Hardware Trade Secret Theft — AAPL at $315, July 30 Earnings Next
stories.summary: Apple filed a landmark lawsuit against OpenAI on July 10, alleging former Apple execs at Jony Ive's io Products directed job candidates to bring Apple parts and download confidential specs; AAPL closed near $315 and the July 30 fiscal Q3 earnings call is the next major catalyst.

stories.headline: Spotify SPOT Down 38% From ATH but Consensus Target $678 — July 29 Earnings the Reset Catalyst
stories.summary: Spotify shares are roughly 38% below their all-time high, but JPMorgan raised its target to $650 and Wells Fargo to $600, pushing the Street consensus to $678 (~40% upside from current levels); Q2 earnings are due July 29 before market open, with analysts watching MAU (target 778M) and gross margins (target 33%+).

stories.headline: NJ ANCHOR Payments Start September 15 — Up to $1,500 for Homeowners; Mortgage Rate Rises to 6.49%
stories.summary: New Jersey's ANCHOR property tax relief program will begin distributing 2026 payments on September 15, with eligible homeowners receiving up to $1,500 ($1,750 with senior bonus); separately, NJ's 30-year fixed mortgage rate has risen to 6.49% this week ahead of Tuesday's critical June CPI report.

stories.headline: World Cup Final at MetLife July 19 — Six Days Away, NJ's Biggest Sports Event in 32 Years
stories.summary: The 2026 FIFA World Cup Final comes to MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford on July 19 at 3pm ET — 12 miles from Montclair — with BTS, Shakira, and Justin Bieber performing at halftime; the largest sporting event ever held in NJ and the last chance to see the World Cup in person this summer.

stories.headline: Adventure Aquarium 'Shark & Ray Summer Adventure' Opens Today — July 13 Through August 16 in Camden
stories.summary: Adventure Aquarium's Shark & Ray Summer Adventure kicks off today in Camden, featuring the Northeast's largest shark collection alongside daily marine biologist talks, hands-on ray encounters, sing-alongs, and dance parties — a family-friendly destination about 90 minutes from Montclair.

stories.headline: Montclair Jazz Soundcheck TOMORROW July 14: Michele Rosewoman & Quintessence at Lackawanna Station — Free
stories.summary: The Montclair Jazz Festival's free outdoor Soundcheck Series continues Monday July 14 with pianist Michele Rosewoman and her acclaimed Afro-Cuban ensemble Quintessence at Lackawanna Station; free and open to all, part of the summer series leading to the August 15 Downtown Jamboree.

stories.headline: Car-Free Church Street Weekend Returns July 17–19 — Outdoor Dining, Shops, No Traffic
stories.summary: Montclair's second pedestrian weekend of 2026 closes Church Street to vehicles from 10am–10pm July 17–19, turning the restaurant-lined block into an outdoor plaza — a great family outing near The Clairidge theater, running concurrently with the World Cup Final weekend.

stories.headline: ADCC Miami Open Registration Closes Tomorrow — Weigh-Ins Friday, Competition Saturday July 11
stories.summary: The ADCC Miami-Dade Open at the Miami-Dade County Fair & Exposition holds weigh-ins July 10 (4–7pm) and competition July 11, with registration closing Thursday July 9; first-place finishers earn 9 ADCC world ranking points in the last major North American opportunity to build toward September's Krakow World Championship.

stories.headline: Helena Crevar vs. Paige Ivette Clymer at ONE: Inner Circle July 17 — Women's Top-Ranked Grappler Returns to Bangkok
stories.summary: Women's world #1 P4P Helena Crevar faces ADCC West Coast Trials winner Paige Ivette Clymer in a 10-minute openweight submission match at Lumpinee Stadium on July 17 — the second ONE Championship appearance for the 19-year-old black belt and a high-profile tune-up nine weeks before ADCC Krakow.

stories.headline: Musumeci vs. Mitchell: Match Accepted by Both Men, Still No Promotion or Date
stories.summary: A week after Bryce Mitchell's callout and Mikey Musumeci's full acceptance, no organization has stepped forward to host their crossover grappling match; both fighters remain publicly committed but the bout is stuck in limbo until a promotion steps up.

stories.headline: France vs. Morocco World Cup QF Tomorrow (July 9, 4pm ET) — Mbappé's 7 Goals vs. Unbeaten Atlas Lions
stories.summary: France arrive at Gillette Stadium unbeaten in five games with 14 goals and only two conceded, with Mbappé setting a new World Cup knockout-stage scoring record at 7 goals; Morocco are equally unbeaten and meet France for the second time in three World Cups after their 2022 semifinal defeat.

stories.headline: Spain vs. Belgium QF Friday July 10 at SoFi Stadium (3pm ET) — Five Clean Sheets vs. Tournament's Biggest Attack
stories.summary: Spain reach Los Angeles with five consecutive clean sheets including a grinding 1-0 over Portugal; Belgium, who demolished the USMNT 4-1, bring De Bruyne and Lukaku as the most dangerous attack Spain have faced — making this the quarterfinal most likely to produce an upset.

stories.headline: Álvarez Transfer Saga Intensifies: Barcelona Sets World Cup Deadline; Atlético Cites €500M Clause
stories.summary: Julián Álvarez publicly confirmed he wants out of Atlético — telling reporters his departure 'is the best thing for everyone' — while Barcelona has given Atlético a World Cup-end deadline and will move to other targets if no deal is struck; Atlético sources insist no fee short of the €500M release clause is acceptable.

stories.headline: Lee Kang-in Still Awaiting Official Atlético Announcement — €40M+ Fee Confirmed, 5-Year Contract Agreed
stories.summary: Despite Fabrizio Romano's 'Here We Go' on July 7, Atlético Madrid still had not posted an official announcement for Lee Kang-in's signing from PSG as of July 8; Korean media confirm the total fee lands slightly above €40M with bonuses on a deal through 2031, making him the first Asian player in club history.

stories.headline: Chip Sell-Off Resumes: Samsung Miss + DeepSeek AI News Sinks Nasdaq 1.16%, VTI Pulls Back From $372
stories.summary: U.S. stocks fell Tuesday after Samsung's disappointing earnings and reports that China's DeepSeek is developing its own proprietary AI chip triggered fresh semiconductor selling; the Nasdaq dropped 1.16%, the S&P 500 fell 0.45% to 7,503, the Dow lost 130 points to 52,925, and VTI retreated from its recent high near $372.

stories.headline: AAPL Dips to ~$310 as Analyst Warns Foldable iPhone Supply Issues Could Miss September Launch
stories.summary: Apple stock slipped in premarket Wednesday after an analyst warned that supply constraints on the foldable 'iPhone Ultra' could push its launch past September 2026; AAPL closed at ~$310 Tuesday, down from its recent $315 high, with the July 30 Q3 earnings call as the next major catalyst.

stories.headline: SPOT Up ~6% in Early July Heading Into July 29 Earnings — 34 of 40 Analysts Rate Buy
stories.summary: Spotify shares have gained roughly 6% since July 1 as investors position for the July 29 Q2 earnings call, where consensus targets 778M monthly active users, 33%+ gross margins, and EPS of ~$3.18; Bank of America's $685 Buy target and the majority analyst consensus make this one of the more anticipated tech earnings of the summer.

stories.headline: NJ Senior Freeze Property Tax Checks Begin July 15 — ANCHOR in September; 30-Year Refinance at 6.13%
stories.summary: New Jersey's Senior Freeze (PTR) program begins mailing 2026 property tax reimbursement checks July 15 for eligible homeowners 65+; ANCHOR benefits arrive in September and Stay NJ in February 2027 — meanwhile, the 30-year fixed refinance rate in NJ sits at about 6.13%, down sharply from the 2023 peak near 8%.

stories.headline: Newark Black Film Festival Opens TONIGHT at Newark Museum of Art — Free Screening of 'When We Free the World'
stories.summary: The 52nd Newark Black Film Festival launches tonight July 8 at 6:30pm with an Opening Night Reception and screening of 'When We Free the World' at the Newark Museum of Art; the free (reservation required) series runs every Wednesday through August 5 — about 12 miles from Montclair via the Garden State Parkway.

stories.headline: Montclair Jazz Soundcheck: Michele Rosewoman & Quintessence Next Monday July 14 at Lackawanna Station — Free
stories.summary: The Montclair Jazz Festival's free outdoor Soundcheck Series continues with jazz pianist and Afro-Cuban ensemble leader Michele Rosewoman and her group Quintessence next Monday July 14 at Lackawanna Station; the series runs through August 4 ahead of the August 15 Downtown Jamboree headlined by Dianne Reeves and Christian McBride.

stories.headline: State Theatre Free Movies: Lilo & Stitch Next Tuesday July 14 in New Brunswick — Two Showings, Crafts at 5:30pm
stories.summary: The State Theatre NJ's free Summer Movies Series continues next Tuesday July 14 with Lilo & Stitch (10:30am and 6:30pm showings), with movie-themed arts and crafts starting at 5:30pm before the evening showing; remaining dates are Zootopia 2 (July 21) and How to Train Your Dragon (July 28) — all free on a 46-foot screen in New Brunswick.

stories.headline: Mikey Musumeci Accepts Bryce Mitchell's Grappling Challenge After 'Gay' Comment
stories.summary: Bryce Mitchell publicly challenged Mikey Musumeci while saying he refuses to watch BJJ because it's "gay"; Musumeci fired back with a full acceptance and jokingly ruled out leg locks and guard pulling, and Mitchell confirmed the match is on — though no date or promotion has been announced.

stories.headline: ADCC 2026 Quietly Removes Izaak Michell From Krakow Roster Amid Active Arrest Warrants
stories.summary: ADCC has removed Izaak Michell from its official Krakow competitor list after months of controversy — including Craig Jones withdrawing his $48k equal-pay pledge in protest — following reports that Michell faces two active Texas arrest warrants related to sexual assault allegations.

stories.headline: ADCC 2026 in Krakow Selling Just 4 Tickets per Day at 15,000-Seat Venue
stories.summary: With Gordon Ryan absent and multiple high-profile stars out, ticket sales for September's ADCC World Championship at the 15,030-seat Tauron Arena Kraków are averaging only ~4 per day; analysts cite weak main-event appeal (Simoes vs. Duarte superfight), steep pricing relative to Polish wages, and the Michell controversy as compounding factors.

stories.headline: Spain 1-0 Portugal: Merino Header Ends Ronaldo's World Cup in Dallas
stories.summary: Mikel Merino came off the bench to head in a stoppage-time winner at AT&T Stadium, eliminating Portugal and likely ending Cristiano Ronaldo's World Cup career at age 41; Spain advances to the quarterfinals to face Belgium on July 10 in Los Angeles.

stories.headline: Belgium 4-1 USA: De Ketelaere Brace Ends Host Nation's World Cup Dream in Seattle
stories.summary: Charles De Ketelaere scored twice and set up another as Belgium dominated the USMNT 4-1, with Romelu Lukaku adding a stoppage-time fourth; Belgium meets Spain in the quarterfinals on July 10 in Los Angeles.

stories.headline: World Cup QF Bracket Confirmed: France-Morocco, Spain-Belgium, Norway-England Headline
stories.summary: The quarterfinal schedule is set: France vs. Morocco (July 9, Boston), Spain vs. Belgium (July 10, Los Angeles), and Norway vs. England (July 11, Miami); Atlético striker Alexander Sørloth and Norway are in the final eight.

stories.headline: Romano Issues 'Here We Go' on Lee Kang-in to Atlético Madrid — Official Announcement Imminent
stories.summary: Transfer insider Fabrizio Romano confirmed all parties agreed on a €35m plus €5m add-ons deal with a five-year contract, with Lee turning down a Middle East offer to join Atlético; the official club announcement is the only remaining step.

stories.headline: Dow Hits 53,000 for the First Time; Foxconn Beat Sparks AI Optimism, VTI Reaches ~$372
stories.summary: U.S. equities opened Q3 strong Monday with the Dow closing above 53,000 for the first time, the S&P 500 up 0.7%, and the Nasdaq up 1.1%, driven by Foxconn's stronger-than-expected quarterly sales; VTI advanced to ~$372, near its 52-week high of $374.70.

stories.headline: Apple and Broadcom Extend Custom Chip Partnership Through 2031; AAPL Climbs to ~$313
stories.summary: Apple and Broadcom extended their chip supply deal covering custom ASICs, cellular modem components, and Wi-Fi/Bluetooth silicon across multiple iPhone generations; AAPL rose ~1% to ~$313 and Broadcom jumped over 3%, removing near-term supply uncertainty heading into July 30 Q3 earnings.

stories.headline: BofA Names Spotify a Top Q3 Pick With $685 Price Target — 41% Upside Implied
stories.summary: Bank of America analyst Jessica Reif Ehrlich issued a Buy call on Spotify with a $685 price target, citing a compelling product roadmap and new subscription pricing tiers — implying ~41% upside — landing three weeks ahead of the July 29 earnings report.

stories.headline: NJ 30-Year Mortgage Rate at 6.03% — Nearly 60 Basis Points Below the National Average
stories.summary: New Jersey's 30-year fixed purchase rate stands at 6.03% versus the national average of 6.61% as of July 6, with the 15-year fixed at 5.38%; NJ homeowners who financed near the 2023 peak of ~8% have a real refinance window, though those with sub-4% pandemic-era mortgages should stay put.

stories.headline: State Theatre NJ Free Summer Movies Kicks Off Today With 'A Minecraft Movie' — Two Showings
stories.summary: The State Theatre's free Tuesday summer series begins today (July 7) in New Brunswick with A Minecraft Movie at 10:30 AM and 6:30 PM; the full July lineup continues with Lilo & Stitch (July 14), Zootopia 2 (July 21), and How to Train Your Dragon (July 28) — all free, with evening shows featuring movie-themed arts and crafts at 5:30 PM.

stories.headline: Vintage Race Cars at NJMP This Weekend — VRG Glasstown Speedfest July 10-12 in Millville
stories.summary: The Vintage Racer Group debuts at NJ Motorsports Park with a three-day event on the Lightning Circuit in Millville (July 10-12), featuring classic sports racers in nearly 3 hours of track time per day — a rare chance to watch authentic vintage road racing about 90 minutes from Montclair.

stories.headline: Iron Chef Morimoto Opens MM by Morimoto in Montclair July 31 — Reservations Open July 16
stories.summary: Iron Chef Masaharu Morimoto is opening MM by Morimoto at 193 Glenridge Ave, Montclair — a nearly 13,000-sq-ft, 200-seat Japanese steakhouse with an omakase bar, Japanese A5 Wagyu, tuna pizza, and premium fish flown from Japan; reservations on Resy open July 16, two weeks before the July 31 dinner launch.

stories.headline: Rosas Jr. Submits Khasan at ACBJJ 21 via RNC; Zabit Reignites Rivalry With Ringside Face-Off
stories.summary: Raul Rosas Jr. captured the ACBJJ 21 All Stars Championship in Moscow on July 5, finishing short-notice replacement Khasan Magomedsharipov with a rear naked choke; after watching his brother lose, Zabit Magomedsharipov appeared ringside for a face-off with Rosas Jr., strongly signaling the originally planned matchup is being rebooked.

stories.headline: ADCC Miami-Dade Open This Saturday July 11 — Registration Closes Thursday, 9 Points for 1st Place
stories.summary: The last major North American ADCC qualifier before September's Krakow World Championship is five days away at the Miami-Dade County Fair & Exposition; registration closes Thursday July 9 ($150), and first-place finishers earn 9 ADCC world ranking points — crucial currency for athletes still chasing invitations to Krakow.

stories.headline: Jorge Masvidal Booked for Submission Grappling Match vs. UFC's Shara Magomedov
stories.summary: Former UFC BMF champion Jorge Masvidal is scheduled to compete in a submission grappling match against rising UFC middleweight Shara 'Bullet' Magomedov, the latest high-profile MMA crossover adding marquee appeal to the fast-growing professional no-gi grappling circuit.

stories.headline: Norway Shocks Brazil 2-0 at MetLife, England Beats Mexico 3-2 at Azteca — R16 Day 2 Results
stories.summary: Alexander Sørloth and Erling Haaland powered Norway to a stunning 2-0 elimination of Brazil at MetLife Stadium — knocking out the tournament favorite — while England survived a 3-2 thriller against Mexico at the Azteca; Atlético striker Sørloth is now a World Cup quarterfinal participant.

stories.headline: Today's World Cup R16: Portugal vs. Spain at AT&T Stadium Dallas (3pm ET); USA vs. Belgium in Seattle (8pm ET)
stories.summary: Two marquee Round of 16 clashes headline Monday's slate: Ronaldo's Portugal faces Atlético's Alex Baena and Spain in an all-Iberian derby at AT&T Stadium in Dallas (3pm ET, FS1), followed by host USA against Belgium at Lumen Field in Seattle (8pm ET, Fox).

stories.headline: Sørloth's Norway Upsets Brazil, Boosting His Exit Value; Lee Kang-in Atlético Deal Still Awaiting Official Announcement
stories.summary: Alexander Sørloth's starring World Cup run — culminating in Norway's 2-0 upset of Brazil — is expected to raise his price in exit talks with Juventus (~€30-35M); separately, Lee Kang-in's agreed move from PSG to Atlético (~€30M, 5-year deal) was described as 'on the verge' by French Football Weekly on July 5, with the official announcement now overdue.

stories.headline: AAPL Near $308 With Wedbush's $400 Target Intact; Foldable iPhone Ultra Is the H2 Bull Thesis Into July 30 Earnings
stories.summary: Apple shares are holding near $308 — up roughly 7% in the holiday week — as Wedbush maintains its $400 price target built around a 10-million-unit production ramp of the foldable 'iPhone Ultra' (~$2,500) and the new Google Cloud AI partnership; fiscal Q3 earnings on July 30 are the next major catalyst.

stories.headline: PSE&G Electric Bills Down 1.8% Since June 1; NJ Homeowners Can Save an Additional 11% by Switching to a Competitive Supplier
stories.summary: Average PSE&G residential electricity bills fell $3.23/month (about 1.8%) starting June 1 with summer credits also in effect; NJ homeowners can cut supply costs a further 11% by switching to a competitive third-party provider at roughly 17.6 cents/kWh versus PSE&G's 19.9 cents — a meaningful saving ahead of peak summer usage.

stories.headline: Spotify SPOT Down 33% YTD Entering Q3 — Analysts See July 29 Earnings as Reset Catalyst
stories.summary: Spotify shares enter Q3 2026 down roughly 33% year-to-date, but multiple analysts — including Bernstein (Buy, reaffirmed July 3) — view the July 29 earnings report as a potential sentiment reset: Q2 guidance targets 778M monthly active users, 33%+ gross margins, and growing Audiobooks+ revenue, all of which could drive a sharp re-rating if met.

stories.headline: Montclair Bastille Day Weekend July 11-12: French Cinema at The Clairidge, Garden Party at Van Vleck House
stories.summary: L'Alliance French Institute is hosting a Bastille Day Weekend in Montclair: Martin Provost's film 'Bonnard: Pierre et Marthe' screens at The Clairidge Saturday July 11 at 7pm; Sunday July 12 brings a town-wide French Shopping Day, outdoor story time at Watchung Booksellers, and a garden party with food and live music at Van Vleck House & Gardens (5-9pm).

stories.headline: Maplewoodstock Music + Arts Festival This Weekend July 11-12 — 22 Bands, 60+ Vendors, Free for All Ages
stories.summary: Maplewoodstock's 21st edition arrives at Maplewood's Memorial Park (580 Valley Street) Saturday-Sunday July 11-12, noon to 9:30pm, headlined by Lettuce, Anders Osborne, and Slap Dragon; the free, all-ages event features 60+ art vendors, a Kid Zone, beer garden, and food trucks — a 5-minute drive from Montclair and one of North Jersey's best summer traditions.

stories.headline: Montclair Flea Returns This Weekend — Saturday & Sunday July 11-12 at Lackawanna Plaza, 11am-5pm
stories.summary: The Montclair Flea is back at 1 Lackawanna Plaza on Saturday and Sunday July 11-12 (11am-5pm), with curated art, vintage goods, and local food vendors in downtown Montclair — a rain-or-shine family outing that pairs naturally with the Summer of Soccer watch parties still running next door at Lackawanna Station.

stories.headline: ACBJJ 21 Live Today in Moscow: Khasan Magomedsharipov Headlines vs. Raul Rosas Jr. in Short-Notice Main Event
stories.summary: Zabit Magomedsharipov's younger brother Khasan takes center stage today at ACBJJ 21 in Moscow, facing UFC bantamweight contender Raul Rosas Jr. in the main event after Zabit's late injury withdrawal; Khasan enters on one week's notice following a first-round submission win at PFL San Diego, making this one of summer's most compelling short-notice grappling matchups.

stories.headline: ADCC Miami-Dade Open July 11: Last Major North American Qualifier Six Days Away
stories.summary: The ADCC Miami-Dade Open at the Miami-Dade County Fair & Exposition on July 11 is one of the final qualifying events before September's ADCC World Championship in Krakow; weigh-ins run July 10 from 4–7pm with competition starting at 8am on the 11th, where winners earn coveted berths at the sport's most prestigious championship.

stories.headline: Morocco 3-0 Canada, France 1-0 Paraguay: World Cup R16 Day 1 Delivers African Dominance and Mbappé Ice
stories.summary: Morocco demolished co-host Canada 3-0 on July 4 with Azzedine Ounahi netting a brace; France edged Paraguay 1-0 via Kylian Mbappé's converted penalty, sending Les Bleus to the quarterfinals for a record fourth consecutive World Cup.

stories.headline: World Cup R16 Day 2: Brazil vs. Norway at MetLife (4pm ET), Mexico vs. England at Azteca (8pm ET)
stories.summary: The Round of 16 continues today with two marquee clashes: Brazil meet Norway at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford at 4pm ET, and Mexico host England at the historic Estadio Azteca in Mexico City at 8pm ET — the first World Cup match at the Azteca since 1986.

stories.headline: Simeone Breaks Silence on Álvarez: Future 'Will Be Resolved This Summer' as World Cup Winds Down
stories.summary: Atlético head coach Diego Simeone addressed the Julián Álvarez situation publicly for the first time, saying the striker's future 'will be resolved this summer' while keeping him in current plans — the clearest signal yet from the dugout that a departure is probable once the World Cup concludes.

stories.headline: Atlético Activates Korean Market Push as Lee Kang-in Signing Awaits Final Stamp
stories.summary: With Lee Kang-in's move from PSG to Atlético all but sealed at ~€30M on a deal through 2031, the club is already building marketing partnerships targeting South Korea's football fanbase — setting up a lucrative commercial audience ahead of his debut as the first-ever Asian player in club history.

stories.headline: Markets Reopen Monday With Dow at Record; July 6 Week: ISM Services, Fed Minutes, Chip Sector Recovery in Focus
stories.summary: U.S. markets resume Monday July 6 after the holiday close with the Dow at an all-time record and VTI near multi-month highs; key watchpoints this week include ISM Services (Monday), Fed meeting minutes (Wednesday), and whether the semiconductor selloff — Micron –7%, SanDisk –14% last week — stabilizes heading into Q3.

stories.headline: Spotify (SPOT): Bernstein Reaffirms Buy; 778M MAU Target and July 29 Earnings Are the Next Inflection Point
stories.summary: Bernstein maintained its Buy rating on Spotify (SPOT) on July 2, citing Q2 guidance of 778M monthly active users and 33%+ gross margins; the July 29 earnings call — the quarter after a 17% EPS beat in Q1 — is the pivotal test for whether the stock's recent recovery can accelerate into H2.

stories.headline: VTI Posts 22.75% One-Year Total Return Through Holiday Close; Index Investors Enter Q3 on Solid Ground
stories.summary: Vanguard Total Stock Market ETF (VTI) closed the Independence Day holiday period with a 22.75% one-year total return including dividends, holding 3,449 stocks with $657.9B in total assets; the fund enters Q3 benefiting from the Dow's record highs and broad market breadth even as tech-sector volatility picked up late in Q2.

stories.headline: World Cup R16 at MetLife Today: Brazil vs. Norway at 4pm ET — Holiday Weekend Soccer 12 Miles from Montclair
stories.summary: The World Cup Round of 16 brings Brazil vs. Norway to MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford at 4pm ET today — just 12 miles from Montclair and accessible via NJ Transit — a natural last-minute family outing for soccer fans before the tournament's big games shift westward.

stories.headline: State Theatre NJ Free Summer Movies Begin Tuesday July 7 in New Brunswick — Weekly Tuesdays Through July 28
stories.summary: State Theatre New Jersey in New Brunswick launches its free Summer Movies Series this Tuesday July 7, with morning and evening screenings on a 46-foot screen; the series runs July 7, 14, 21, and 28 — about 12 miles from Montclair and a great free school-break option for families with kids.

stories.headline: Branchburg's America 250 Celebration Today at White Oak Park: Rock Wall, Ninja Course, Live Music, Fireworks Through 9pm
stories.summary: Branchburg wraps its Semiquincentennial celebration today July 5 at White Oak Park (12pm–9pm) with live music, food trucks, and a full kids zone including a rock wall, bungee trampoline, ninja warrior obstacle course, and pony rides — a great final 4th-of-July-weekend outing about 35 miles from Montclair.

stories.headline: ADCC 2026 Full 128-Competitor Roster Confirmed: Three Defending Champs Out, Ruotolo Twins and All UFC BJJ Champions Also Missing
stories.summary: With all 128 slots confirmed for September's ADCC Worlds in Krakow, the bracket shows historic star-power gaps — defending 66kg champion Diogo Reis joins Mica Galvao (77kg) and Giancarlo Bodoni (88kg) among withdrawals, while neither Kade nor Tye Ruotolo, Nick Rodriguez, nor any current UFC BJJ titleholder will compete.

stories.headline: ADCC Croatia Open Qualifier Live Today in Zadar; Miami-Dade Open Follows July 11
stories.summary: The ADCC global qualifier roadshow reaches the Croatia Open today at Kresimir Cosic Sports Hall in Zadar, with athletes competing for spots at September's Krakow World Championship; the Miami-Dade Open on July 11 is the next stop on the buildup schedule.

stories.headline: Kaynan Duarte vs. Yuri Simoes Superfight Gains New Weight as ADCC 2026 Field Thins
stories.summary: With three defending champions and the Ruotolo twins absent from Krakow's 128-person bracket, the Kaynan Duarte vs. Yuri Simoes superfight for Gordon Ryan's vacated title has become the clearest marquee contest — and the match most likely to define who rules the super-heavyweight division for the next era.

stories.headline: Argentina Survive World Cup Scare, Beat Cape Verde 3–2 AET: Messi Scores as Islanders Equalize Twice
stories.summary: Argentina survived their most dramatic World Cup test in years on July 3, winning 3-2 in extra time after Cape Verde equalized twice; Messi and Lautaro Martinez scored for Argentina, but Lopes Cabral's stunning long-range curler deep in extra time was only canceled by a last-gasp Diney Borges own goal.

stories.headline: World Cup R16 Double-Header Today: Canada vs. Morocco in Houston (1pm ET), France vs. Paraguay in Philadelphia (5pm ET)
stories.summary: The 2026 World Cup Round of 16 opens with two July 4th games: Canada faces Morocco at NRG Stadium in Houston, and France — led by Mbappé's record six knockout-stage goals — takes on tournament upset-specialists Paraguay at Lincoln Financial Field in Philadelphia.

stories.headline: Atlético Transfer Roundup: Lee Kang-in Official Announcement Imminent; Álvarez–Barcelona Deadlock Continues
stories.summary: Atlético Madrid's official announcement of Lee Kang-in's signing from PSG (≈€30M, 5-year deal) is expected within days, making him the club's first Asian player; separately, Barcelona president Laporta confirmed the €100M bid for Julián Álvarez remains on the table while Atlético holds firm at €150M.

stories.headline: AAPL Closes at $308.63, Best Session of 2026 (+4.84%): Foldable iPhone Ultra Plans and Google Cloud AI Deal Drive Pre-Holiday Surge
stories.summary: Apple shares surged 4.84% on July 3 to close at $308.63 — the stock’s best single-day gain of 2026 — after reports Apple targets 10 million units of a foldable ‘iPhone Ultra’ (~$2,500) and disclosed a new Google Cloud AI partnership; Q3 earnings on July 30 are the next major test.

stories.headline: Apple in Talks to Source Chips From Two Pentagon-Blacklisted Chinese Makers (CXMT and YMTC) to Ease Global Memory Crunch
stories.summary: Apple is negotiating supply agreements with both CXMT and YMTC — two Chinese chipmakers on the Pentagon’s entity list — to ease the AI-driven memory shortage that has forced price hikes across its product line; the strategy requires U.S. government clearance and carries significant bipartisan political risk.

stories.headline: NJ 30-Year Mortgage Rate Edges Up to 6.36% as of July 3; Markets Closed for Independence Day with Dow at All-Time Record
stories.summary: New Jersey’s 30-year fixed mortgage rate ticked up to 6.36% (refinance 6.88%) as of July 3, reversing last week’s dip to 6.25% and translating to ~$2,995/month on a median NJ home with 20% down; U.S. equity markets are closed today for the holiday with the Dow at an all-time record and VTI near multi-month highs.

stories.headline: Livingston’s 89th Annual July 4 Celebration Features NJ’s Largest Auto Show (9am) and Fireworks at 9:15pm
stories.summary: Livingston’s 89th Independence Day celebration opens with what organizers call New Jersey’s largest annual auto show at 9am, followed by food, music, and family activities, capped by fireworks at 9:15pm — about 12 miles from Montclair and a great day-trip option for motorsport and car enthusiasts.

stories.headline: Elizabeth’s July 4 Celebration Combines America’s 250th Birthday Events With World Cup 2026 Fan Zone Watch Party
stories.summary: Elizabeth’s all-day July 4 celebration at Veterans Memorial Waterfront Park combines America’s 250th anniversary programming with a 2026 World Cup Fan Zone watch party — live entertainment, food vendors, kids’ activities, and fireworks at dusk — one of NJ’s most unique holiday options this year.

stories.headline: America’s 250th: Trenton Opens Old Barracks Museum With Revolutionary War Reenactments; Princeton Morven Museum Hosts Free Festival
stories.summary: Trenton’s Old Barracks Museum reopens today with Revolutionary War reenactments, a multicultural parade, and walking tours marking America’s 250th birthday; Princeton’s Morven Museum hosts a free outdoor festival with music and artmaking — both excellent day-trip options for curious kids, about 45 minutes from Montclair.

stories.headline: Zabit Magomedsharipov Sidelined Before ACBJJ 21 Comeback; Brother Khasan Steps In vs. Rosas Jr.
stories.summary: Former UFC top-10 featherweight Zabit Magomedsharipov has been forced out of his long-awaited July 5 grappling return at ACBJJ 21 in Moscow due to injury; younger brother Khasan Magomedsharipov stepped in on short notice to headline the card against UFC bantamweight Raul Rosas Jr.

stories.headline: ADCC Opens Roadshow Rolls On: Croatia Today, Miami July 11, Krakow Worlds Sept 12–13
stories.summary: The ADCC open qualifier series continues with the Croatia Open on July 4 and the Miami-Dade Open on July 11, maintaining the global buildup to September's ADCC World Championship in Krakow, Poland.

stories.headline: Spain Crushes Austria 3–0 in Round of 32; Spain vs. Portugal Set for July 7
stories.summary: Mikel Oyarzabal scored twice and Pedro Porro added a header as Spain dominated Austria 3-0 on July 2 — their first World Cup knockout-stage win since 2010 — setting up an all-Iberian Round of 16 clash with Portugal on July 7.

stories.headline: Lee Kang-in Transfer to Atlético Madrid Imminent; 5-Year Deal, ~€30M Fee, Announcement Expected This Week
stories.summary: PSG midfielder Lee Kang-in has agreed personal terms on a contract through 2031 with Atlético Madrid at a base transfer fee of approximately €30 million, with an official announcement expected within days as PSG finalizes its two replacements.

stories.headline: Grimaldo Breaks Silence After Completing Atlético Move: 'My First Choice Was Always Atlético'
stories.summary: New Atlético signing Alejandro Grimaldo gave his first public comments after completing his move from Bayer Leverkusen, saying the club was his preferred destination all summer and issuing a competitive warning to La Liga and Champions League rivals.

stories.headline: Laporta: Barcelona Has 'Moral Obligation' to Sign Álvarez; €130M Bid Set Post-World Cup
stories.summary: FC Barcelona president Joan Laporta publicly declared the club has a moral obligation to sign Julián Álvarez, with player-club personal terms already agreed; Barcelona plans to make a formal ~€130M offer to Atlético after the World Cup, while Atlético is holding firm at €150M cash with no installments.

stories.headline: Dow Hits All-Time High on Soft June Jobs Report; Markets Closed July 3 for Independence Day
stories.summary: The Dow Jones surged 595 points to a fresh record on July 2 after June nonfarm payrolls came in at just 57,000 versus 113,000 expected, reducing odds of an imminent Fed rate hike; Apple led the rally with a 4.8% jump while semiconductor stocks continued their slide.

stories.headline: Apple (AAPL) Surges 4.8% on July 2; Q3 Earnings July 30 With Google Gemini AI Strategy in Focus
stories.summary: AAPL rebounded sharply on July 2, rising 4.8% as the soft jobs report lifted the Dow; the stock's next major test is July 30 Q3 earnings, where Apple has guided 14–17% revenue growth and investors will scrutinize the newly announced Google Gemini AI integration and progress on the memory chip shortage.

stories.headline: Spotify Pulls 500K Fake Streams Tied to $3M Kalshi Prediction Market Bet on 'Earrings'
stories.summary: Spotify removed over 500,000 artificial streams that had fraudulently propelled Malcolm Todd's 'Earrings' to the top of its U.S. charts after discovering the streams were tied to $3 million in bets on the prediction market Kalshi; Spotify has demanded both Kalshi and Polymarket remove its branding and is actively investigating the manipulation.

stories.headline: Chip Stocks Sink Again Even as Dow Records: Micron –7%, SanDisk –14%, AMD –4.3%
stories.summary: Semiconductor shares extended their steep decline on July 2 — Micron fell 7%, SanDisk tanked 14%, and AMD dropped 4.3% — deepening the market split between traditional blue-chip sectors and AI-infrastructure plays as investor doubts about near-term spending returns continue to build.

stories.headline: Montclair's Walnut Street Kitchen Closing July 31; Farewell Filipino-American Pop-Up 'Bunso' Runs July 7–31
stories.summary: Globally inspired Walnut Street Kitchen at 98 Walnut St. in Montclair is closing after four years, along with its sister spot 3rd Joint Slice Shop + Bakery; the team marks its final month with farewell pop-up Bunso, offering Filipino-American dining at the same address July 7 through July 31.

stories.headline: Jersey City Council Unanimously Rejects 15% Property Tax Hike; $255M Deficit Remains Unresolved
stories.summary: Jersey City's council voted down a revised 15% property tax increase on July 1 following fierce public backlash, even after the state offered a $120M financial lifeline; Mayor Solomon warned that residents could face a large lump-sum increase later in 2026 if the $255 million budget deficit is not otherwise resolved.

stories.headline: Whitesbog Blueberry Summer Fest Today (July 3): Live Music, Vendors, and Family Fun in Burlington County
stories.summary: Whitesbog Historic Farm & Village in Burlington County is hosting its Blueberry Summer Fest today, July 3, featuring live music, artisan vendors, local food, and outdoor family activities — a festive way to kick off the Independence Day holiday weekend within easy driving distance of Montclair.

stories.headline: Helena Crevar vs. Paige Ivette Clymer Set for ONE: The Inner Circle on July 17
stories.summary: 19-year-old women's grappling star Helena Crevar returns to ONE Championship on July 17 to face ADCC West Coast Trials winner Paige Ivette Clymer in a 10-minute openweight submission grappling match at Lumpinee Stadium in Bangkok — her second ONE appearance after a successful debut earlier in 2026.

stories.headline: UFC BJJ 2 Confirmed for July 31: Tackett Defends Title Against Renato Canuto
stories.summary: UFC's grappling promotion series returns July 31 with champion Andrew Tackett putting his belt on the line against Brazilian submission grappling star Renato Canuto — the second installment of the UFC's expanding no-gi grappling card series and a major late-summer event for the sport.

stories.headline: ADCC 2026 Is 10 Weeks Out With Open Roster Spots After Twin Withdrawals
stories.summary: With ADCC Worlds in Krakow set for September 12-13, organizers now face pressure to name replacement invitees following last week's confirmed withdrawals of both Mica Galvao and Giancarlo Bodoni; the grappling community is awaiting official bracket updates with the superfight between Kaynan Duarte and Yuri Simoes still the marquee booking.

stories.headline: Spain vs. Austria Kick Off Today at SoFi Stadium in World Cup Round of 32
stories.summary: Spain — with newly signed Alejandro Grimaldo on the squad — face Austria this afternoon (July 2) at 3pm ET at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood in the World Cup Round of 32; a win puts them on a collision course with Portugal, who also play Croatia tonight at 7pm ET in Toronto.

stories.headline: Lee Kang-in's Atlético Madrid Signing Expected to Be Officially Announced This Week
stories.summary: Korean media report an 'official deal imminent' for Lee Kang-in to move from PSG to Atlético Madrid for approximately €30M, with personal terms already agreed on a contract through 2031; if completed this week as expected, he becomes the first Asian player in Atlético's history.

stories.headline: Barcelona President Laporta Publicly Addresses Álvarez Deadlock With Atlético
stories.summary: Barcelona president Joan Laporta said he 'spoke personally with Atlético de Madrid and made the situation clear' regarding Julián Álvarez, but acknowledged the offer was rejected because Atlético had 'no alternative'; Barça have yet to improve on their initial €100M bid as Atlético hold firm — and Atlético's FIFA complaint against Barça for alleged tampering adds further legal pressure to the standoff.

stories.headline: Argentina vs. Cape Verde Tomorrow in Miami; Messi Leads World Cup Scoring Charts
stories.summary: Lionel Messi's Argentina — leading the World Cup scoring charts with nine goals in three group games — face World Cup debutants Cape Verde at Hard Rock Stadium in Miami Gardens tomorrow (July 3) in the Round of 32; Cape Verde's remarkable three-draw group stage earned them a historic first-ever knockout berth.

stories.headline: June Jobs Report Released Early Today; S&P 500 Dips in Holiday-Shortened Session
stories.summary: The June nonfarm payrolls report was released this morning (July 2) a day early due to the Independence Day holiday — economists expected 115,000 new jobs and unemployment holding at 4.3%; the S&P 500 eased ~0.08% as traders digested the numbers before markets close entirely on July 3 for the holiday.

stories.headline: AAPL Holds Near $294 in Quiet Pre-Holiday Week; July 30 Earnings Are the Next Catalyst
stories.summary: Apple stock has recovered from mid-June lows near $275 to trade around $294-295, with investors largely on hold through the July 4 weekend; the fiscal Q3 earnings call on July 30 is the next major event, where analysts project $1.89 EPS and ~$110.8B in revenue — results that will test whether the stock can reclaim its early-June highs above $315.

stories.headline: Spotify (SPOT) at $460 With Strong Q1 Beat Behind It; July 29 Earnings Approaching
stories.summary: Spotify shares are trading near $460 as of July 1, with a Buy consensus from 20+ analysts and an average price target of $594; Q1 2026 EPS came in at $3.45 versus the $2.95 forecast — a 17% beat — and Audiobooks+ is on track to hit $100M ARR this month, giving investors multiple tailwinds heading into the July 29 earnings report.

stories.headline: NJ 30-Year Fixed Mortgage Rate Eases to 6.25% at the Start of July
stories.summary: New Jersey's 30-year fixed mortgage rate has slipped to approximately 6.25% as of July 1 — down from the 6.69–6.88% range seen in late June — translating to a monthly payment of roughly $2,995 on a median NJ home ($569K with 20% down); would-be buyers and refinancers may want to act before any potential Fed rate hikes later this year.

stories.headline: Maplewoodstock Reveals Full Lineup for July 11-12: Lettuce, Anders Osborne, Slap Dragon Headline
stories.summary: The free, all-ages Maplewoodstock Music + Art Festival at Maplewood's Memorial Park (July 11-12, noon to 9:30pm nightly) has released its headliner lineup — funk/jazz act Lettuce, blues guitarist Anders Osborne, and Slap Dragon — alongside 50+ art vendors, a Kid Zone, food trucks, and a beer garden; it's a short drive from Montclair and totally free.

stories.headline: July 4th Weekend: Bloomfield and West Orange Host Free Family Celebrations Near Montclair
stories.summary: Beyond Montclair's own Saturday morning parade, nearby options include Bloomfield's Foley Field (The Infernos band plus fireworks at dusk, July 4) and West Orange High School's free community festival (food trucks, DJ, Kids Zone, 12-6pm July 4) — plenty of free family-friendly choices within a short drive for the long Independence Day weekend.

stories.headline: Montclair Flea Open This Holiday Weekend at Lackawanna Plaza — Saturday and Sunday
stories.summary: The Montclair Flea returns to 1 Lackawanna Plaza on Saturday July 4 and Sunday July 5 (11am-5pm both days), with curated art, vintage goods, and food — a rain-or-shine family-friendly option in downtown Montclair that complements the morning parade and gives something to do before heading to evening fireworks.

stories.headline: Vintage Racer Group Weekend at NJ Motorsports Park July 10-12 — One Week Away
stories.summary: Classic and vintage car racing arrives at NJ Motorsports Park in Millville next Thursday through Saturday (July 10-12) with the Vintage Racer Group, featuring road and sidecar racing on Thunderbolt Raceway — just ahead of the New Jersey Lottery SpeedTour bringing F4 U.S. and Formula Americas open-wheel racing July 31-August 2.
